content.original: The Laser Bellona was massively upgraded with an XL engine, armored motive system, Streak LRMs, and a targeting computer This update gives Support Cizins a run for their money. In the late 3060s, under Khan James Cobb's command, Clan Hell's Horses began preparation for a renewed presence in the Inner Sphere. The scientist caste saw this as an opportunity to create a new cavalry vehicle, which they called the Bellona. Designed as a striker and flanker, the Bellona carries enough firepower on a nimble enough frame to keep up with even the fastest-advancing lines. The original specs called for tracks, but test pilots for the vehicle cited that 'speed is armor', which led to the Bellona being redesigned as a hovertank. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: After the Word of Blake was defeated in the Jihad, Maxwell-Pulaski Motors modified the design slightly and produced it for the Republic of the Sphere in 3084. The main differences are the removal of its Blakist features. The infantry bay was reduced to four tons, and the C3i system was replaced by a C3 slave unit. The machine gun ammunition was reduced to half a ton. All these changes increased the pod space available to the RAF Bollas by four and a half tons, but the turret can only mount fifteen tons of equipment. The Stealth Armor was retained, as was the Guardian ECM suite. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. content.content: После поражения Слова Блейка во время Джихада компания Maxwell-Pulaski Motors немного доработала конструкцию и начала производство этого танка для Республики Сферы в 3084 году. Главные отличия заключаются в удалении блейкистских особенностей. Отсек для пехоты был уменьшен до четырёх тонн, а система C3i была заменена на C3 Slave. Боезапас пулемёта был уменьшен до полутонны. Все эти изменения увеличили доступное пространство под вооружение на четыре с половиной тонны, но башня может нести только пятнадцать тонн оборудования. Броня Stealth была сохранена, как и система РЭБ Guardian. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 5/8 гексов / 150/240 метров. content.original: Despite the original being introduced in 2564 updated Condors are still in production as of the start of the 32nd Century. Substantial armor of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit designed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover tanks available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest vehicles in its weight class. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 25 Left 140 25 Right 140 25 Rear 120 25 Turret 140 25 Total 720 125 Quirk: Quick Off The Line

content.content: Несмотря на то, что оригинальная модель была представлена в 2564 году, обновленные Condor по-прежнему производятся в начале 32-го века. Солидная броня весом не менее шести тонн и различные комплексы вооружения средней и большой дальности делают Condor по-прежнему актуальным. «Кондор» — тяжелый кавалерийский юнит, предназначенный для быстрого реагирования на изменения в ходе боя, был одним из немногих тяжелых ховер-танков, доступных на момент его появления. Этот огромный танк способен развивать скорость до 129 км/ч и крейсерскую скорость 86 км/ч, что делает его одним из самых быстрых транспортных средств в своей весовой категории. content.original: Exclusively deployed by the Republic of the Sphere, the DI Morgan (Hyper Laser) was a desperate attempt to hold back the advancing Clan threat. Hastily refitted with what supplies could be spared, the 100 ton tank is equipped with a 300-rated XL Engine; and armed with a pair of RISC Hyper Lasers as well as a pair of Machine Guns. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. Обладая максимальной скоростью, превышающей скорость большинства мехов, Galleon был мобилен, но не имел достаточной защиты: ранние модели несли всего три с половиной тонны брони. content.original: This version of the Padilla introduced in 3134, replaces the standard Padilla weaponry with a Gauss rifle tied into a Targeting Computer. Not to be confused with the original Padilla, the Padilla Tube Artillery Tank was a Republic of the Sphere vehicle meant to fulfill a similar role. Originally designed and produced by Aldis Industries at the request of Precentor Martial Cameron St. Jamais, the Padilla Tube Artillery Tank serves as the main conventional artillery support platform used by the Republic Armed Forces. The Padilla is well-protected for a vehicle of its size. This is good as the tank's low top speed could make it an easy target for fast moving units or airstrikes. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: First appearing in 3056, the Palisade Defense Tank is a 60-ton defensive tank found throughout the wealthier parts of the Periphery. Based on an older tank design dating back to the Succession Wars, the Palisade is designed as a multi-role tank capable of engaging Mechs or Vehicles. Capable of speeds of 60 km/h, the Palisade (Streak LRM) is powered by a 240-rated Fuel Cell and carries 11.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The main gun is an LB-10X, with a Clan SLRM-15 supporting this at longer ranges. An MG provides some limited anti-infantry capabilities and CASE mitigates crew danger should an ammo explosion happen. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.original: Unveiled in 3110 the Partisan AA Vehicle, a lighter take on the original Partisan Air Defense Tank, was meant to be cheaper and faster but still be equally effective in the anti-aircraft role. Produced in 3134, this version of the Partisan AA would give the vehicle a longer reach than before, while gaining secondary weaponry which the Standard Model lacked. Gone is the standard LB-5X Class autocannons, in their place are a pair of Class 2 Hypervelocity Autocannons. Though lacking the punch of the Standard's bigger LB-5Xs, the HVAC/2s accuracy is improved by adding a Targeting Computer to the vehicle. As a secondary weapon, the vehicle is fitted with a 10-tubed Rocket Launcher in the turret. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 120 25 Left 120 25 Right 120 25 Rear 90 25 Turret 90 25 Total 540 125 Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting

While never produced in large numbers, all post–Star League era Successor State militaries maintained a number of the vehicle for combat on their most inhospitable planets. Biome Restrictions: None. Хотя он никогда не производился в больших количествах, все армии государств-наследников после эпохи Звёздной Лиги имели некоторое количество этого транспортного средства для ведения боевых действий на своих самых негостеприимных планетах. content.original: The Saladin Mk II HCV is a redesigned version of the original Third Succession War-era Saladin combat vehicle prized for its hitting power and speed. This new version of the Scarborough Manufacturers' famous line of hovercrafts would be first produced during the mid-thirty-second century. While retaining the speed of the original model, the Saladin MK II is considerably better protected by Scarborough engineers using 5.5 tons of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor. The tank's primary weapon is its front-mounted Magna Flarestar Snub-Nose Particle Projection Cannon. While this has less punch than the original's heavy Autocannon, the PPC has no ammunition needs, allowing it to keep fighting longer and at greater ranges. Biome Restrictions: None. Хотя её мощность меньше, чем у тяжёлой автопушки оригинала, зато PPC не нуждается в боеприпасах, что позволяет вести бой дольше и на больших дистанциях. Ограничения биома: нет. content.original: The SM Tank Destroyer was designed as a speedy infighter by scientists from Clan Nova Cat. The machine is a cheap and effective combat vehicle. The vehicle has unique 'glass' dual cockpits on the front of the vehicle that are functionally identical while mounting a smaller anti-infantry turret just behind its left side cockpit. The vehicle's unique split cockpit design allows the cockpit modules to eject from the vehicle. Due to its appearance, the SM1 was dubbed the 'Suicide Machine' by its first pilots because they felt overexposed with the tank's all ferro-glass cockpit. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: The Albatross does not specialize in one role and is more of a workhorse design than anything else. The 'Mech carries an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher which gives it long range and indirect fire support capabilities. This is backed up by an Oriente Model O LB-X Autocannon/10 and a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser which give the 'Mech a powerful long-range punch. The 'Mech carries a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser which allows the 'Mech to engage an enemy at the edge of the medium to long-range envelope. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.

content.original: Clan Wolf's migration to the Wolf Empire abandoned the only manufacturing site for the capable Night Wolf in their former occupation zone. A crash retooling of the Washburn factory produced the Albatross C as a replacement, but it proved a pale imitation of the rapidly dwindling original. Plans to mass-produce the derisively dubbed 'Sooty Albatross' were shelved until Star Colonel Othar’s desperate rearmament of the Wolf Empire, and even then, assignment to this "failed" model was thought to be an ill omen. content.original: The Albatross does not specialize in one role and is more of a workhorse design than anything else. The 'Mech carries an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher which gives it long range and indirect fire support capabilities. This is backed up by an Oriente Model O LB-X Autocannon/10 and a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser which give the 'Mech a powerful long-range punch. The 'Mech carries a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser which allows the 'Mech to engage an enemy at the edge of the medium to long-range envelope. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.

content.original: The Alpha Wolf's initial specification called for a blend of the Warwolf and Timber Wolf in an assault 'Mech package, with the Wulfen's stealth armor. It shares electronics packages with the Wulfen and Warwolf —amongst others— more as a means to streamline development than for any advanced abilities of the systems themselves. Applying the Wulfen's stealth   armor onto an assault 'Mech raised eyebrows initially, although this decision hinged not on a desire for the Alpha Wolf to fill roles traditionally associated with stealth, such as scouting and infiltration. Rather, the benefits that stealth armor offered in disrupting enemy targeting systems cemented the selection, as it would allow the Alpha Wolf to survive longer in standup fights.

content.original: The Amarok is a unique assault 'Mech among the Clan Wolf touman, intended as a close combat 'Mech. It was built and conceived under Ramiel Bekker's idea of combating the Death From Above (or DFA for short) tactics being employed by Clan Jade Falcon. However, lacking time he had to seek assistance from Clan Sea Fox as he did with the Stormwolf. It was during his time with Clan Sea Fox that he started to investigate the Hammerhead, a new Sea Fox 'Mech, and from that 'Mech he borrowed design choices that would later be a part of the Amarok. For example, the use of Hardened Armor for better protection and modified hand actuators for use in close combat.

content.original: The Arion, developed by Clan Hell's Horses, is a versatile hybrid combat unit designed for both BattleMech and tank configurations. Equipped with an ER Large Laser and two SRM-4 launchers, the Arion is capable of delivering devastating firepower at medium to long ranges. With a top speed of 97 km/h, it can rapidly traverse the battlefield and reposition as needed. The Arion's conversion capability allows it to operate as either a fast, heavily armed BattleMech or a heavily armored tank with a low profile, depending on the mission's needs. In BattleMech mode, the Arion is capable of agile and dynamic movements, thanks to its quadrupedal design. When converted to a tank, the Arion provides an armored, low-profile platform with a powerful punch. Despite its versatility, the Arion is not as heavily armored as traditional BattleMechs, and its conversion process takes time and resources, making it less effective in rapidly changing combat situations. Nevertheless, its ability to perform in multiple roles makes it a valuable asset in a wide range of missions. Quirk: QuadVee Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

Using 26 tons of state of the art Ballistic-Reinforced armor and Heavy Duty Gyro, combined with the fact both side torsos mount a C.A.S.E. content.original: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.

content.content: Пройдя боевое крещение в 2765, изначальный дизайн Atlas II был спроектирован Департаментом исследований и разработок Терранской Гегемонии, а именно - Отделом вооружения оригинальной Звёздной Лиги, чтобы поддерживать технологическое превосходство над другими Великими Домами. Мех был эксклюзивом королевских войск СОЗЛ. Спустя 20 лет, когда генерал Александр Керенский, во время Исхода, отдал приказ лояльным ему соединениям присоединиться к нему, ни один пилот этой грозной машины не осмелился ему воспротивиться. Atlas II несет массу разнообразного вооружения, такого как LB 10-X, пара ER Large Lasers и одна LRM-20 для атак на дальние расстояния. Для ближнего боя он может похвастаться двумя Medium Pulse Laser и Holly SRM-6. Также в оба борта был установлен CASE для защиты от детонации боекомплекта.

content.original: The Awesome is traditionally used in a vanguard role when penetrating enemy defenses. The Awesome's massive firepower also lends it to defensive actions, acting as a mobile turret when necessary. Because of its reliance on PPCs, the Awesome is able to act independently for extended periods of time. This trait is also useful in siege situations where the 'Mech can keep up a constant barrage, allowing it to win battles of attrition through bleeding an enemy dry. The only downsides to the Awesome is its low maneuverability and lack of rear-facing weaponry, making it vulnerable to being outflanked and surrounded by lighter 'Mechs, although good intelligence and a well-deployed screening force can mitigate this issue.
content.prevOriginal: The newest Awesome to walk off of Technicron’s production lines, the Awesome 11H incorporates Technicron’s advances in manufacturing Clantech. Clan Endo Steel is combined with Clan Double Heat Sinks and a trio of Inner Sphere Heavy PPC’s to create a potent Assault platform.
content.content: «Потрясающий» традиционно используется в роли авангарда при прорыве вражеской обороны. Массивная огневая мощь Awesome также позволяет использовать его в оборонительных действиях, при необходимости выступая в роли мобильной турели. Благодаря использованию PPC, Awesome способен действовать автономно в течение длительного времени. Эта особенность также полезна в осадных ситуациях, когда мехи могут вести постоянный обстрел, позволяя выигрывать битвы на истощение за счет обескровливания противника. Единственным недостатком Awesome является низкая маневренность и отсутствие заднего оружия, что делает его уязвимым для захода и обстрела в спину более легкими мехами, хотя хорошая разведка и хорошо развернутые силы прикрытия могут смягчить эту проблему.

content.original: The -12S builds upon the endo-steel chassis of prior models, upgrading it with a home-built Clan-grade engine and lasers. The weight savings enabled Defiance’s engineers to follow the weaponry layout of the -3S. Armor levels match the toughest Banshees, creating a very strong and fast assault ’Mech, albeit one with a challenging heat curve. Alpha-striking will shut the ’Mech down, so MechWarriors are advised to use either the main or secondary weapons, but not both at once. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster is one of the best known 'Mechs in existence. Originally designed to be the largest and most powerful 'Mech for the Star League armies in the 27th century, the sheer size of the BattleMaster, combined with the cost and resources needed to build one, meant the 'Mech can only be manufactured on a few planets. Still, those lucky enough to pilot a BattleMaster can attest to some of the stories surrounding the 'Mech. With good reliability, firepower and armoring, the BattleMaster is equally adept anchoring an assault lance or serving as a command vehicle.

content.content: Универсальный и мощный, BattleMaster — один из самых известных мехов. Изначально разработанный как самый большой и мощный мех для армий Звёздной Лиги в 27 веке, BattleMaster в сочетании с его огромными размерами, стоимостью и необходимыми ресурсами для его постройки, означал, что этот мех можно производить лишь на нескольких планетах. Тем не менее, те, кому посчастливилось его пилотировать, могут подтвердить некоторые мифы, связанные с этим мехом. Благодаря высокой надёжности, огневой мощи и бронированию, BattleMaster одинаково хорошо подходит как для поддержки штурмового копья, так и в качестве командирской машины.

content.original: This variant is produced by Clan Sea Fox on Twycross for their second line forces. Based on Clan technology its armament closely mirrors the 3M, with four forward firing Series 2b ER medium lasers, a Type VI Streak SRM-6, a Type DDS 'Kingston' ER PPC in the right arm, and twin Series V machine guns in the left arm. Eighteen double heat sinks keep heat under control, but the Targeting Computer makes it easy for Clan warriors to defeat foes. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster is one of the best known 'Mechs in existence. Originally designed to be the largest and most powerful 'Mech for the Star League armies in the 27th century, the sheer size of the BattleMaster, combined with the cost and resources needed to build one, meant the 'Mech can only be manufactured on a few planets. Still, those lucky enough to pilot a BattleMaster can attest to some of the stories surrounding the 'Mech. With good reliability, firepower and armoring, the BattleMaster is equally adept anchoring an assault lance or serving as a command vehicle.

content.content: Универсальный и мощный, BattleMaster — один из самых известных мехов. Изначально разработанный как самый большой и мощный мех для армий Звёздной Лиги в 27 веке, BattleMaster в сочетании с его огромными размерами, стоимостью и необходимыми ресурсами для его постройки, означал, что этот мех можно производить лишь на нескольких планетах. Тем не менее, те, кому посчастливилось его пилотировать, могут подтвердить некоторые мифы, связанные с этим мехом. Благодаря высокой надёжности, огневой мощи и бронированию, BattleMaster одинаково хорошо подходит как для поддержки штурмового копья, так и в качестве командирской машины.

content.original: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.

content.content: «Чёрный рыцарь» был разработан как боевая машина первой линии, так и как командный боевой мех на уровне роты и батальона для Сил обороны Звездной Лиги. Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

It also has an advanced Endo-Composite skeleton protected by thirteen and a half tons of armor. Seventeen Clan-spec double heat sinks keep heat load under control. The right arm carries a Medium Shield, and it has an advanced Targeting Computer. Its weaponry is all Clan-spec. content.original: Reengineered from the -5D design before it reached production maturity, Johnston Industries created the -5R and immediately put the highly durable chassis into production. Reduced dependency on expensive imported components keeps the new Caesar low-cost. The CES-5R can hang in a fight longer than most 'Mechs its size, thanks to hardened armor and a mostly energy-based arsenal. Its largest flaw remains the limited maneuverability, leaving the 'Mech vulnerable against more agile foes. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The Carrion Crow is a Raven Alliance OmniMech designed alongside the heavier and more expensive War Crow. Deployment of the Carrion Crow is limited to the Raven touman, with the Alliance Military Corps not receiving any of these 'Mechs. A fast medium 'Mech, the Carrion Crow is intended to be a standard medium 'Mech for the Alliance. The Carrion Crow is built on an endo steel chassis, which houses its 280-rated XL engine that allows the 'Mech to move at a top speed of 111 km/h. Protection is provided by nine and a half tons of ferro-lamellor armor, while 14.5 tons of pod space allows the Carrion Crow to carry weapons that let it effectively fight heavier units.

Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. content.original: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The C configuration carries an ATM-6 in the left arm, an ER Large Laser in the right arm, and a Plasma Cannon in the right torso. The missile launcher and plasma cannon each have two tons of ammo. Additional protection is provided by an ECM Suite to jam enemy C3 networks. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The D features an Improved Heavy Large Laser and AP Gauss Rifle tied into a Targeting Computer. Originally it was named the Roweena after Roweena Kurita, but the ISF suspected the designer was a Black Dragon Society sympathizer so a new name was assigned. The Cricket uses every weight saving technology possible to free enough room to have a high ground speed and pack on more armor. Capable of reaching over 150 km/h, it can also jump 180 meters at a time thanks to six jump jets. Despite its high speed and jump capability, the Cricket is unpopular for scouting and recon as it has a cramped cockpit and no electronics.

content.original: The Crucible is designed to inflict the largest amount of damage in the fastest amount of time, to achieve this it carries a Gauss Rifle in each arm and side torso together with 8 tons of ammunition. Though the twelve double heat sinks are more than enough for the Gauss Rifles, the additional heat sinks allow the Crucible pilot to ignore heat from plasma weapons and Inferno rounds. A Micro Pulse Laser is also fitted for anti-infantry operations. Fifteen tons of standard armor covers the chassis. To free room and weight for this equipment the Crucible uses an 300-rated XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, as a result the Crucible can reach 54 km/h max speed and has 90 meter jump range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Dervish carries as its main weapons two Federated 10-Shot LRM launchers. These missile launchers give the Dervish the long-range capability needed to provide fire support to friendly units and are safely embedded in the torso as opposed to the exposed launchers on other 'Mechs. A ton of ammunition per launcher provides sufficient endurance for any but the most prolonged battles. For close combat, the Dervish carries two Federated 2-Shot SRM launchers and two ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers. The SRM launchers are completely self-contained within the forearms, allowing them to be aimed quickly, and fed by a ton of ammunition each. The lasers are placed just above the launchers and ensure the 'Mech is still capable of fighting should it run out of missiles. The Dervish is capable of jumping 150 meters and is protected by seven and a half tons of armor.

content.original: After the DVS-10 was met quite unfavourably by the AFFS, Corean fell under severe pressure to bring back the original Devastator and its powerful punch. However, they instead reworked the assault 'Mech once more. The resulting DVS-11 is the compromise no one knew they needed. Nearly as fast as the -10, the return of the classic weaponry—dual Gauss rifles and a PPC—allows this Devastator to tangle with the toughest of Atlases or Stalkers. It is regarded as a premier line-breaker, and its swift sales have prompted Norse-Storm executives to approach Corean for a licensing agreement. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.

По скорости и бронезащите он не уступает «Атласу», но обладает более высокой потенциальной огневой мощью с 55,5 тонн свободного пространства для оружия и оборудования. Именно за эти качества в криминальных кругах Синдиката Дракона мех окрестили Daishi (псевдояпонское название «Великая смерть»), и это название раз за разом подтверждало свою мрачную правоту.

content.original: The ENF-5R is relatively low-tech compared to the Enforcer III. It can be constructed quickly and in large numbers by the reborn Kallon Industries lines following the loss of New Avalon. The LB 10-X is easily produced, while the large reengineered laser counters some of the newer armors of modern battlefields. Although slower than the Enforcer III, its light engine is more durable, and with the addition of CASE II the -5R can stay in the field longer. As with earlier models, the size of the head-mounted sensor pod varies, depending on which targeting system is installed. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: In most regards, the 5A is an updated version of prior Firefly variants, incorporating modern technologies to make it a significantly more powerful 'Mech. The weaponry is mildly upgraded from the original armament. The FFL-5A's most notable improvements are however its increased engine size and the additional functionality of its partial wings - mostly cosmetic in prior models. This addressed one of the chief criticisms of the Firefly: poor mobility for a light 'Mech. The FFL-5A Firefly has reclaimed its status as one of the Dragoons' primary light combat units, which will undoubtedly make it an attractive purchase for other mercenary commands Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Firestorm focuses on anti-infantry and anti-vehicle combat. Similar to the Shadow Cat, the Firestorm uses a single main weapon supported by several smaller ones. The right arm carries an Inner Sphere-produced plasma rifle fed by two tons of ammunition, while a plasma cannon mounted in the right torso and fed by one ton of ammunition provides additional power. Supporting these weapons are a flamer, micro pulse laser, and ER medium laser mounted in the left arm. Built on an endo-steel skeleton, the Firestorm uses a 250-rated extralight engine to reach a speed of 86 km/h. A MASC system mounted in the left torso allows it to sprint at speeds of 108 km/h. Seven improved jump jets let the 'Mech cover 210 meters in a jump. Protection is provided by nine tons of ferro-fibrous armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The Firestorm was created by a combined group of Spina Khanate and Wolf Empire warriors and technicians. Based on a new OmniMech derived from the Shadow Cat, this long term project wasn't ready for production; however, a BattleMech could be developed from a planned configuration, thus laying the groundwork for the Firestorm. With this in mind, the Clan Wolf warriors favored a weapons suite focused on incendiary operations. This allowed the Wolf touman to rapidly expand its second line and garrison forces without incurring the cost of expensive OmniMechs.

The Fire Moth T is armed with a pair of Improved Heavy Medium Lasers, a Streak SRM-2 and an SRM-6. A Supercharger pushes the Fire Moth to even faster speeds. content.original: Designed as a close combat skirmisher the Gargoyle J also has impressive maneuverability. Seven torso mounted Improved Jump Jets give the 'Mech a 210 meter jump range. This, along with its 86 km/h top speed, allows the 'Mech to easily bring its close range laser batteries into range. The heavy firepower of four Improved Heavy Medium Lasers fires from the right arm, while a brace of seven ER Small Lasers fires from the left. These weapons allow the J to eviscerate a foe’s armor up close, but leaves the J helpless at longer ranges and forces it to rely on its maneuverability to avoid enemy fire as it closes. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Gargoyle is an extremely fast assault OmniMech developed with the Timber Wolf as replacements for the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech. The Gargoyle is therefore commonly seen among Clan Wolf, and was a featured assault OmniMech during the Clan Invasion. The Gargoyle earned the code name Man O' War from the Inner Sphere forces because of its effectiveness. This dependable design eventually spread throughout the Clans, and can be seen with any of their Galaxies now.

content.original: Following on the heels of the Jade Falcon’s adoption of physical attacks, the Gargoyle K represents a paradigm shift in tactics of other Clans. Mounting a six ton Hatchet in its right arm the Gargoyle K is the first Clan 'Mech so equipped. Adding to the danger of the hatchet is a Supercharger that allows the K to run at over 100 km/h, a staggering speed for an assault 'Mech. Focused solely on short range destruction, the K's other weapons are for use up close. Each of the 'Mech’s torsos comes equipped with a Streak SRM-4 launcher. All three launchers are fed by a single ton of ammo in the CASE II protected left torso. Four Improved Heavy Medium Lasers reside in the left arm. To ensure no targets can hide from the K an Active Probe is housed in the right torso. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Developed as a complement to the Griffin in the later years of the Jihad, the Ghost is a medium strike 'Mech that saw considerable use in the years after the formation of the Republic of the Sphere. Developed by the Lyran Commonwealth and elements of the former Free Worlds League the Ghost carries an extensive array of electronic warfare equipment into combat. A Beagle Active Probe allows the Ghost to find enemy units, while Stealth Armor and a Guardian ECM Suite allows the 'Mech to live up to its name. With excellent land speed and formidable medium-range weaponry, the Ghost is ideal for hunter-killer and heavy raiding missions, especially when paired with Griffins.Another variant introduced in 3133 removes the SRM-6 rack from the standard Dark Age Ghost and replaces it with a Chainsaw to minimize logistical needs, or potentially to disguise it as an IndustrialMech. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: An 80-ton Quad Mech, the Goliath entered production in 2652. Partially based on data from the earlier Scorpion Quad Mech, the Goliath carries a heavier payload of weapons and armor, intended to boost it's effectiveness on the battlefield. Powered by a 320-rated Fusion Core, the Goliath GOL-1H is armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-10's. A pair of Machine Guns provide closer ranged firepower.

Пара пулемётов обеспечивает огневую мощь на ближней дистанции.

content.original: The complex actuator design and the lack of credible defensive weaponry leaves the Goliath open to close-range attacks and battle armor swarms. Osaka Heavy Metrics’ recently introduced GOL-7K has a deadly counter to such threats: M-pods concealed in the center torso and in each leg. These defenses are hidden behind blow-away panels designed to resemble maintenance hatches, providing an unwelcome surprise for anyone who gets too close. With a focus on mediumrange combat, this Goliath variant is part of their expansion to add a true BattleMech to their stable of combat support quad IndustrialMechs. How and when Osaka acquired the plans is unknown, but espionage is suspected. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

With a focus on mediumrange combat, this Goliath variant is part of their expansion to add a true BattleMech to their stable of combat support quad IndustrialMechs. How and when Osaka acquired the plans is unknown, but espionage is suspected. Особенность: Многоприцельный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.14

content.original: The Götterdämmerung is a Heavy class BattleMech first fielded by the Lyran Commonwealth in 3138, the 'Mech's German name translates to twilight of the gods or ragnarök. The Götterdämmerung's durability is due in part of layers of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor, while Blackstone would move the cockpit of the 'Mech to the torso. The Torso-Mounted Cockpit's ejection system is highly complex, making escape from the Götterdämmerung difficult under certain circumstances. MechWarriors piloting the 'Mech need also be wary of losing their side torsos, due to the split placement of their life support systems. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Dragon and later Grand Dragon have been a staple of Draconis Combine cavalry units since the early days of the Succession Wars. Attempts by LAW to modernize this emblematic BattleMech over the past century largely met with success and never strayed from the basic performance profile. LAW wisely chose to keep with tradition in this latest variant, while taking advantage of the influx of Clan-grade weaponry. In order to reduce costs, many components are shared with the newest Lancelot variant. The resulting DRG-12K is far and away the most deadly Grand Dragon to enter DCMS rolls Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Grand Dragon is the successful follow-up to the Dragon BattleMech. Just like the Dragon, the Grand Dragon quickly became a favorite in the DCMS, with nearly every line unit fielding a company of either design. Production of the Grand Dragon continued unabated until the Jihad, when the Word of Blake devastated LAW's factories in 3068. It took two years for LAW to get new Grand Dragon factories up and running, the first on Nykvarn followed by Abiy Adi and Savinsville, and ensure the continued use of the 'Mech in years to come.

Swamping the standard PPC for a clan spec ER alternative and the LRM rack for a smaller Streak 10 allows the Griffin to strike at almost any range. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Founded in 3132, Jötunn BattleWorx's one purpose was the local development of reinforced chassis technology in a workable BattleMech. Flush with Bear-Krona thanks to Gray Monday appropriations, Jötunn took an old Grizzly and rebuilt it. The Bruin’s superior durability and similar armament had relegated the Grizzly to obsolescence decades earlier. Four years of testing saw endless permutations of weapons to find the ideal combatant. To allocate mass lost to the chassis, the sturdy old reactor was replaced with an XL model with no loss in resilience, proving the concept. Its arsenal remained largely the same, though a Plasma rifle replaced the Gauss rifle and targeting was improved for all weapons. The Grizzly that marched off Jötunn’s first production line in 3138 was highly compromised, but the lessons learned informed the development of a new generation of OmniMechs Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Grizzly is a BattleMech that was developed by Clan Ghost Bear scientists in the 30th century. Unfortunately, the design excels at no one thing, so it never carved a niche in the Clan's touman. Thirteen tons of armor are mounted on an Endo Steel frame. Jump jets are mounted so that the Grizzly can leap up to 120 meters at a time. Aside from the 'jack of all trades, master of none' moniker, the Grizzly is also poorly engineered. Slagged armor tends to get stuck in joints and weapons, while the actuators are difficult to repair in their own right.

Jump jets are mounted so that the Grizzly can leap up to 120 meters at a time. Aside from the 'jack of all trades, master of none' moniker, the Grizzly is also poorly engineered. Slagged armor tends to get stuck in joints and weapons, while the actuators are difficult to repair in their own right.

content.original: The Hammerhead is a medium-sized Clan BattleMech designed as a skirmisher by Clan Sea Fox. Designed to loosely resemble a hammerhead shark, the design is intended to be aggressive with its opponents, yet also built around the concept of never getting knocked off its feet. Despite its merely adequate weapons array, the Hammerhead has achieved great success as a shock trooper wading though enemy formations to brawl with opponents twice its size at close range.

content.original: The Harpagos is a Clan Hell's Horses' heavy BattleMech designed for long-range combat. Armed with two Gauss rifles, the Harpagos can deliver devastating pinpoint damage at extreme ranges. While lacking jump jets, it boasts a top speed of 64 km/h, enabling it to reposition and maintain distance from its enemies. Its armor is also thick enough to withstand enemy attacks, making it a formidable opponent on the battlefield. However, the Harpagos has a large profile and is relatively slow compared to other heavy BattleMechs. Pilots must use careful positioning and cover to ensure its survival, while making use of its Gauss rifles to strike at enemies from afar. Quirk: QuadVee Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. Using information from captured Daishis and data gleaned from the construction of the Firestarter OmniMech, which was shared by the Draconis Combine, the end result is a powerful OmniMech capable of defending itself in most combat situations. The Hauptmann is built on a standard chassis and powered by a 285 fusion engine, adding to the 'Mech's durability as it cannot be killed by a side torso loss. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. For protection, the Hauptmann carries eighteen and a half tons of armor and has CASE fixed in the right torso to protect against an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Based on a previously rejected redesign of the venerable Cyclops, the Hecatoncheires downsizes the classic cyclops to 65 tons in weight. A Beagle Active probe paired with a C3 unit make up the mech's specialist electronics. 4 Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-6s with Artemis IV provide a nasty punch at close range, while a Gauss Rifle covers longer ranges. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: What is now known as the Hellcat had its humble origins in a Clan's desperation nearly a century ago. One of the many projects born out of Clan Nova Cat's post-Abjurement rebuilding program was a radical take on the Conjurer BattleMech. Jade Falcon merchants took advantage of their old rival's panic, swapping sorely needed raw materials for access to the Cats' ballooning catalog of 'Mech chassis. Falcon technicians and scientists reworked an atypical Conjurer variant to emphasize flexible firepower over the Nova Cat model's speed and energy-based weaponry. Named as a subtle wink to both the BattleMech's creators and the Conjurer's Spheroid name, their early Hellcat saw only limited production before the Jihad.

content.original: The Hellion is a product of Clan Ice Hellion and their philosophy that espouses speed above all else. Based on the Mist Lynx, the Hellion is a fast OmniMech that has respectable firepower. This light 'Mech is rather difficult to kill, incorporating five and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. To save weight, the Hellion also uses an Endo Steel chassis. While it is not especially fast for its size, the Hellion does use MASC to allow for bursts of additional speed. The Hellion sports no fixed weapons on its chassis. The T configuration consists of three Medium Pulse Lasers, a LRM-10 launcher and three Streak SRM 2 Improved One Shot launchers. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Хеллион» — творение клана Ледяного Хеллиона и их философии, ставящей скорость превыше всего. Созданный на основе «Мист Линкса», «Хеллион» — это быстрый омнимех с впечатляющей огневой мощью. Этот лёгкий мех довольно сложно уничтожить, так как он оснащён пятью с половиной тоннами ферроволоконной брони. Для снижения веса «Хеллион» также использует эндостальной каркас. Хотя он не особенно быстр для своих размеров, «Хеллион» использует систему MASC, позволяющую ему резко увеличивать скорость. Конфигурация T состоит из трех средних импульсных лазеров, пусковой установки LRM-10 и трех Streak SRM 2. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.98 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Hermes II was first produced in 2798, based on the original Hermes BattleMech that had been used by the Star League. A heavy scout, the Hermes II boasted respectable weaponry, armoring, and speed, allowing it to easily brawl with lighter 'Mechs or survive an encounter with heavier 'Mechs and retreat. Out of all medium-weight 'Mechs at the time the Hermes II was the easiest to perform field maintenance on, leading to its nickname 'old reliable.' As combination scout and light strike platforms, Hermes II 'Mechs often operated alone, employed for missions for which lighter 'Mechs were too fragile and heavier 'Mechs too clumsy. The Hermes II was in its element when operating in a restrictive environment like a forest or city, where it could employ a most unusual tactic of setting its surroundings on fire to escape pursuit. Since most 'Mech pilots would naturally avoid a fire to prevent overheating and the flames interfered with most thermal scanners, starting a blaze allowed the Hermes II to more easily slip away.

content.original: The Hierofalcon is a medium Clan OmniMech designed primarily as a striker unit by Clan Jade Falcon. As part of the push to be ever more flexible in movement, the 'Mech features a 270-rated extralight engine, allowing the mech to move at speeds up to 97.2 km/h. The addition of a permanently equipped partial wing adds dual benefits, both increasing jump distance and cooling capabilities. The 'Mech's hull is protected by seven and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, giving it modest protection from enemy fire, while an ECM suite provides additional protection from other threats.

content.original: When Clan Hell's Horses occupied the site of the W-7 Facilities in 3142, Clan Wolf had not taken everything. The boneyard where Highlanders had been refit to IIC-standard for seventy years was extensive. With the Inner Sphere desperately rearming, spare Highlanders viable for upgrading were a rare commodity, so the Horses improved the line to build the SL-XT chassis while sourcing parts from New Oslo to Alnabog, the latter to our profit. While not quite the same as the ancient Clan 'Mech, the new Highlander IIC 4 proved a formidable package when unleashed in Operation Noyan. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content: Когда в 3142 году клан Адских Лошадей занял территорию объектов W-7, клан Волка вывез не всё. Свалка, где «Горцы» на протяжении семидесяти лет переделывались в IIC, была обширной. В условиях, когда Внутренняя Сфера отчаянно перевооружалась, запасные «Горцы», пригодные для модернизации, были редким товаром, поэтому Лошади усовершенствовали производственную линию для создания шасси SL-XT, поставляя туда детали от Нового Осло до Алнабога. Несмотря на то, что новый Highlander IIC-4 был не похож на предыдущие древние клановские варианты, он оказался грозным дополнением в операции «Ноян». Особенность: Укреплённые ноги Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.2 Лимит приводов рук: Right Lower

content.original: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. Though no new Highlanders have been produced in over a century, several hundred are still in scattered use throughout the touman of every Clan.

content.content: Один из самых популярных боевых мехов Звёздной Лиги, многие Highlander сопровождали генерала Александра Керенского во время изгнания. Некоторые из них были законсервированы, но многие попали в тумены Кланов. По мере развития технологий системы вооружения модернизировались, пока наконец не появилась конструкция, известная как Highlander IIC. Хотя новые «Горцы» не производились уже более ста лет, несколько сотен из них всё ещё используются в туменах всех кланов.

content.original: Built by Luthien Armor Works of New Samarkand, the Hitotsume Kozo is a medium BattleMech designed to serve in the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery. This 'Mech's creation was partially influenced by an unofficial cultural rebirth. Keeping this in mind, LAW styled the appearance of the Hitotsume Kozo after the ancient Japanese Bushido armor worn by the samurai warriors during that time period on Terra. It received a poor reception by front-line troops due its advanced features and high heat output; however, it was appreciated when transferred to less-favored combat units, such as Ghost Regiments, as these less-fickle warriors adapted to the design's quirks and turned it into an effective combat unit. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
content.content: «Хитосуне Козо», построенный компанией Luthien Armor Works на Новом Самарканде, представляет собой средний боевой мех, предназначенный для службы в составе мобилизованных солдат Синдиката Дракона. На создание этого меха отчасти повлияло неофициальное культурное возрождение. Учитывая это, LAW стилизовали внешний вид Hitotsume Kozo по образцу древних японских доспехов бусидо, которые носили самураи в тот период на Терре. Он был плохо принят войсками на передовой из-за высокой теплоотдачи и ряда особенностей; однако он был оценен по достоинству при передаче менее популярным боевым подразделениям, таким как Призрачные полки, поскольку эти менее капризные воины адаптировались к специфики конструкции и превратили его в эффективную боевую единицу. Особенность: Стабильный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The original Reunification War era model, save for using an older Dalban Sniper targeting and tracking system, was all but identical to the 4C.

Предназначенный для поддержки пехоты, Hoplite является медленным для среднего меха, с максимальной скоростью всего 64,8 км/ч. Однако его 11,5 тонн брони и тяжелый арсенал, впечатляющие для меха его размера, делают Hoplite прочной машиной, способной выбраться из большинства ситуаций. Оригинальная модель эпохи Войны за воссоединение, за исключением использования более старой системы наведения и слежения Dalban Sniper, была практически идентична модели 4C.

content.original: The Horned Owl, or Peregrine as the Inner Sphere designated it, is a light, fast second-line BattleMech capable of highly accurate fire. It was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion as a rugged submersible construction ’Mech and was later rebuilt for combat[1]. A harassing platform, the Horned Owl is also a capable dueling 'Mech. content.original: The Inferno heavy OmniMech was introduced by StarCorps Industries of Crofton after New Avalon fell to the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery in the Dark Age. With twenty-nine tons of pod space available and protected by thirteen and a half tons of armor, the Inferno became a popular unit in the AFFS. By building on an Endo-Steel chassis with a Compact Gyro engineers were able to free up a lot of space in the traditionally crowded center torso. This freed room for heavy weapons in the most heavily protected part of the 'Mech. In every configuration the main weapons are mounted in the center torso, with additional weaponry in the side torsos (often in over the shoulder mounts), leaving the arms free for physical attacks.

content.original: The Ion Sparrow, initially designated as the Butcherbird when first encountered by the Lyran Intelligence Corps, was introduced by Clan Jade Falcon on Alyina as an experimental testbed for the advanced partial wing system. The Ion Sparrow uses an endo steel chassis, XL engine, ferro-fibrous armor, and small cockpit to save weight. Eight jump jets have been mounted in the right and left torso, and when paired with the partial wing, allows the Ion Sparrow to cover 300 meters per jump. The wing also works with the double heat sinks to dissipate more heat.

content.original: The newest generation of Falcon OmniMechs represents a rift in design philosophy that mirrors the rift inside the Clan. The savage adherents of Malvina Hazen pilot more stylized ’Mechs like the Gyrfalcon and Shrike, whereas more moderate warriors prefer the toned-down aesthetics of newer machines like the Jade Phoenix, just as they prefer a toned down version of combat. The Jade Phoenix embodies what it means to be a true Jade Falcon, as did its namesake, the legendary Aidan Pryde.

content.original: The JagerMech was designed as an anti-aircraft platform and long-range fire support unit intended to correct several perceived faults of the original Rifleman. After the FedCom Civil War further development of the JagerMech split along three different lines. The first were simple field refits of the original JM6-DD, such as the H and DG models. The second was a complete overhaul as part of Victor Steiner-Davion's 'Redesign for Davion Pride' program, resulting in the JagerMech III. The third was the creation of a divergent line, the JM7 series, built on a slightly heavier chassis massing 70 instead of 65 tons that was nevertheless not considered enough of a change to change the chassis name.

content.content: «Ягермех» был разработан как противовоздушная платформа и средство огневой поддержки дальнего действия, призванное исправить несколько выявленных недостатков оригинальной модели Rifleman. После Гражданской войны ФедСода дальнейшее развитие JagerMech разделилось на три линии. Первая представляла собой простую переделку оригинального JM6-DD в полевых условиях, например, модели -H и -DG. Вторая представляла собой полную переделку в рамках программы Виктора Штайнера-Дэвиона «Редизайн для гордости Дэвиона», результатом которой стал JagerMech III. Третья линия заключалась в создании ответвления — серии JM7, построенной на чуть более тяжёлом шасси массой 70 тонн вместо 65, что, тем не менее, не было сочтено достаточным изменением для смены названия шасси.

content.original: The G9B is an updated variant for the Dark Ages, fielded by the Capellan Confederation. Replacing the Gauss rifle for a Clan ER PPC was a deliberate choice to alleviate the Jinggau's ammunition dependency while maintaining damage output and eliminating the risk of internal explosions. The armor was increased to align it with other modern CCAF cavalry designs such as the Mortis and Vandal, and the medium pulse laser was upgraded to an X-Pulse model. However, the most significant changes were buried deep within: triple-strength myomer lets the 'Mech increase its mobility when it runs hot, and a supercharger provides additional speed boosts so it can quickly close with the enemy. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

After the conflict, the New Earth-based manufacturing center would be seized by Republican forces and the production output would pour into the ranks of the Republic of the Sphere. content.original: In an attempt to use the popularity of the Longbow platform as a missile boat to move it into more of a closer combat profile, the -10K was created. However, this was not meet with any larger success despite using both CASE and increasing the protection to include 16 tons of armor, as there are other 'Mechs in the same weight range that were seen as performing the role better. The -10K mounted two Ultra AC/20s combined with an ER Large Laser and a Medium Pulse laser. Six tons of autocannon ammunition was carried, but only four tons of them under CASE protection - a choice that generated quite a bit of critique. Another point of contention was the XL engine used, as this was seen as making the 'Mech more prone to engine problems and reducing its reliability. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Longbow, introduced in 2480, has seen service in the armies of the Inner Sphere since the days of the Star League and is one of the most well-known fire support 'Mechs in existence. As a fire-support 'Mech though, the Longbow is a trusted and reliable machine that can be counted on to carry out the mission it is designed for. The primary weapons on the Longbow are its LRM launchers, four in all, a pair of 20s and a pair of 5s, letting the Longbow put out 50 LRMs into any target it can see.

content.original: Touted as one of the most effective 'Mechs of all time, the Marauder saw wide usage by the SLDF before and during their Exodus from the Inner Sphere. During the years before their return, the Clans developed a followup to the venerable design, later dubbed the Marauder IIC, representing the pinnacle of Clan weapons technology prior to the advent of the OmniMech. Like other IIC designs, visual similarities between it and its predecessor initially led ComStar to incorrectly label the design as a mere refit of the original.

content.original: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. Designed as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL Engine is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of armor which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Named for the door guards who serve to ward off evil spirits from a home, the Men Shen is the first OmniMech to come from the Capellan Confederation, it borrows heavily from the Raven BattleMech for its basic design concept. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a vulnerable but light VOX 330 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is augmented by MASC system allowing the 'Mech to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The Men Shen comes with eleven tons of armor, giving it a respectable amount of protection. The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Названный в честь стражей у дверей, которые отгоняют злых духов от дома, Men Shen является первым омнимехом, пришедшим из Конфедерации Капеллы. В своём базовом концепте, мех многое заимствует у Raven. Он построен на легком шасси из эндостали и приводится в действие уязвимым, но легким двигателем VOX 330 XL, который обеспечивает ему максимальную скорость 97,2 км/ч, которая дополняется системой MASC, позволяющей меху разгоняться до 129,6 км/ч короткими рывками. Men Shen поставляется с одиннадцатью тоннами брони, что обеспечивает ему внушительный уровень защиты. Men Shen несет на своем базовом шасси активный зонд Beagle, что позволяет ему выполнять разведывательную роль независимо от его конфигурации. Для оружия и оборудования Men Shen имеет семнадцать тонн свободного пространства. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.95 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Naga II is a further continuation from Clan Wolf's first OmniMech, the Woodsman. What originally was a technical failure during the first batches of production of the Woodsman got converted into the Naga, later refined into the Naga II, but still suffering from bad reputation as a partial failure. The Naga II keeps much of of the core design the same as the original Naga; an Endo Steel internal structure, 9 tons of standard armor and a 400 XL engine.

content.original: The general unpopularity of the Nexus, along with its link to the Word of Blake, drove it to the brink of extinction. It therefore came as a shock when a new variant, flagged as the NXS1-C, appeared in the reborn Com Guard during Malcolm Buhl's last stand on Epsilon Eridani. The -C proved more versatile than its predecessors. It was pressed into striker and anti-infantry support roles, and it proved deadly to the combined-arms formations of the Republic assault force. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The BattleMech known as the Nexus was originally based on the Jackrabbit, a light scout and combat vehicle and infantry support 'Mech built for the Star League Defense Force by Skobel MechWorks. Ironically, the Jackrabbit ended testing two weeks before Stefan Amaris seized power on Terra and was instead primarily used by units loyal to Amaris against the SLDF in General Kerensky's drive to liberate the Terran Hegemony. Though the SLDF captured Skobel's plant relatively intact, thanks to the stigma of being used against his forces Kerensky ordered it shutdown and the unloved Jackrabbit disappeared into history outside of ComStar's records. With the Com Guards looking to recoup their grievous losses in the wake of the Battle of Tukayyid, in 3054 Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht ordered the Skobel plant reactivated, reworking the slower Jackrabbit into a fast and highly mobile recon striker 'Mech he renamed the Nexus.

The Nightstar ceased production a year after it first walked off the factory line and would not see production again until the late 3050’s. Powered by a 285-rated XL Engine, the Nightstar 10D is armed with a pair of Light Gauss Rifles and a pair of Clan ER Large Lasers. A Medium X-Pulse Laser provides extra firepower at close quarters. With over half of its tonnage dedicated to weapons, ammunition, and equipment, the Nova Cat packs a punch in all configurations. Some recent configurations increased the speed and agility that Clan customers typically desire.

content.content: Долгое время считавшийся карманным штурмовым омнимехом, Nova Cat жертвует скоростью ради огневой мощи. Более половины его веса приходится на вооружение, боеприпасы и оборудование, поэтому Nova Cat впечатляет своей мощью во всех конфигурациях. Некоторые последние варианты увеличили скорость и маневренность, что обычно требуют клиенты из Кланов.

content.original: The T loadout combines three Large Pulse Lasers with two ER PPC. Attempting to address the main drawback of the base design, the loadout also adds a Supercharger for more burst of speeds. A total of 18 double heat sinks try to keep the 'Mech cool enough to not shutdown, but due to the full energy loadout the cooling is still so insufficient that an inexperienced MechWarrior can easily over do it with a few full Alpha Strikes. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Orion has long held an important place in the Clan Wolf Touman, and the Orion C 2 is a capable heir to the favored ride of Aleksandr Kerensky. The response has been mixed, however, as it continues to use non-Clan structural components to reduce the strain on the Wolves’ industrial resources. The weapons, though, are mostly Clan. Short to medium range is covered by a Streak rack and ER medium laser, backed up with a large pulse laser in the left arm. The Orion’s standard right torso ballistic weapon was replaced by an ER large laser, both for weight and range. Having been burned by the superior range of extended LRMs, the Wolves are experimenting with the weapon system on the C 2. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Ostroc carries as its primary weapons two Fuersturm-C Large Lasers in the left and right torsos. These give the Ostroc good medium to long range damage capabilities. The Ostrocs secondary weapons are two Fuersturm-b Medium Lasers also mounted in the side torsos and a Totschlagen SRM-4 launcher in the right torso for close-range combat, with one ton of reloads carried in the center torso. While the Ostroc's laser-heavy weapons payload allows it to operate well as a guerrilla fighter since it has limited dependency on supply lines, its short arms are a handicap in close combat, and the shocks of hand-to-hand fighting can easily damage the Fuersturm systems.

content.original: The Ostscout was designed as a pure recon BattleMech by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional; the Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other designs can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. The OST-12R is a stealth version of the Ostscout, combining a clan ER Large Laser with a Guardian ECM suite, Stealth Armor, a Light fusion engine and the classic 8 side-torso Jump Jets. To free the needed weight the OTT-12R further uses Endo-Composite internal structure. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Остскаут» был разработан компанией Ostmann Industries как чисто разведывательный боевой мех. Поэтому он был полностью ориентирован на сбор данных и выход из сложных ситуаций — задачи, для которых он подходит идеально. Ostscout достаточно быстр, чтобы избежать большинства ловушек, и мало какие другие разработки могут сравниться с ним по скорости и манёвренности. OST-12R — это стелс-версия Ostscout, сочетающая в себе большой ER-лазер с системой РЭБ Guardian, стелс-броню, лёгкий термоядерный двигатель и классические 8 прыжковых двигателей в полуторсах. Для снижения веса в OTT-12R используется внутренняя структура из эндокомпозита. Особенность: Улучшенные сенсоры Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The Ostsol was designed as an all-energy-weapon alternative to Ostmann Industries' previous heavy BattleMechs, the Ostwar and the Ostroc. Armed with a mix of lasers and requiring little resupply, the Ostsol is nearly impossible to interdict and is able to operate independently of supply lines for extended periods of time. A versatile 'Mech, the Ostsol can operate as part of heavy lances in order to provide close-range firepower or lead recon and raiding lances thanks to its high speed and advanced electronics.

content.original: This Wolf Empire variant is a much more thorough melding of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies. Built around a few central Inner Sphere-grade components - a 270-rated XL engine, seven standard jump jets, and an endo steel frame - while clad in five and a half tons of Clan-grade ferro-fibrous armor. Now better armored than the original and capable of a remarkable 151 km/h top speed, the Pack Hunter 5's sole weapon is the Clan-tech ER PPC that gave the original model its bite. Though this means the 5 is still plagued by the original's inability to engage multiple opponents, the sheer speed gained in this upgrade makes it ever easier to avoid most return fire. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble.

Он также представляет собой результат нового партнёрства между Волками Фелана и Гончими Келла, поскольку броня и средства связи изготовлены Гончими и были переданы Волкам в обмен на эндосталь. Следуя за стремлением их хана к лёгким и быстрым конструкциям, учёные Волка разработали Pack Hunter таким образом, чтобы он был быстрым и обладал болючим укусом. Несмотря на лёгкость четырёхтонной брони, этот боевой мех должен использовать свою скорость и манёвренность, чтобы оставаться в стороне от неприятностей.

content.original: Few BattleMechs designed and produced in the Inner Sphere after the fall of the first Star League managed to become as beloved as the Penetrator. A mainstay of AFFS, LCAF, and mercenary heavy lances, it has a well-deserved reputation for phenomenal staying power. The variant was initially created by refitting battle-damaged Penetrators, but soon multiple production lines were dedicated to building this new variant. For the AFFS, struggling to recover from devastating losses of personnel and materiel, the PTR-8D has been a lifeline, and demand is sky-high.

content.original: For the longest time it seemed the first iteration of the Pillager was consigned to history. The idea of a jumping close-assault 'Mech with twin autocannons, however, was too good not to revisit, albeit half a millennium later. Used as a bodyguard of Gauss-equipped variants, the new 6Z variant features two massive Clan LB 20-X autocannons with a deadly punch at close to medium distances. The ER large laser offers only token long-range firepower, and this pitiful, lone back-up weapon can be the downfall of inexperienced pilots. The strategios issued an order to keep the new Pillager near support 'Mechs in open terrain, but MechWarriors eager to take the fight to the enemy often choose to ignore it. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original: The largest BattleMech ever built by HildCo Interplanetary, the Pillager is built as a larger version of the Victor, and is intended for assaulting urban centers and hardened fortifications. These design parameters were paramount as the SLDF mobilized to wage the Reunification War. Later Pillagers were upgraded with more cutting-edge Star League technology. Production of the Pillager halted not because its facility was destroyed, but the advanced Gauss rifle and XL engine production lines had been obliterated by the end of the Second Succession War. Curiously, HildCo did not restart production of the original PLG-1N, rather the Pillager lines only began production again in 3058 when advanced components were once again available for the PLG-3Z.

content.original: The Pouncer was originally a test bed design that was upgraded to combat specifications on the orders of then-IlKhan Ulric Kerensky, as it was realized that a more mobile 'Mech was needed when combating Inner Sphere forces. The Pouncer is built on a lightweight DSAM Endo 4 Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 240 XL engine which gives it a maximum speed of 97.2 km/h. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with five Grandthrust Mk. Four jump jets that allow it to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Pouncer has a respectable six tons of Forging ZM15 Ferro-Fibrous armor. Overall, the Pouncer is an excellent OmniMech with fifteen and a half tons of pod space, allowing it to carry a wide variety of weapons payloads.

Pouncer построен на легком шасси из эндостали DSAM Endo 4 и оснащен двигателем 240 XL, который обеспечивает ему максимальную скорость 97,2 км/ч. Мобильность меха повышена за счет пяти прыжковых двигателей Grandthrust Mk. 4, которые позволяют ему прыгать на дистанцию до 150 метров. Для защиты от вражеского огня Pouncer имеет внушительные шесть тонн ферроволоконной брони Forging ZM15. В целом, Pouncer является превосходным омнимехом с 15,5 тоннами пространства под вооружение, что позволяет ему нести широкий спектр вооружения.

content.original: The -9G is Technicron's attempt to redefine the unit as a skirmisher. A light engine and an advanced endo-steel chassis allow for many improvements, including much-improved durability. Four targeting computer-assisted medium lasers provide all-around accurate firepower, backing the 'Mech's main armament of Clan Streak SRM racks. The Quickdraw -9G's most audacious feature is speed, with a supercharger and MASC combination allowing the 60-ton ’Mech to reach ludicrous speeds for its size. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

content.original: The Quickdraw was originally built in 2779 as a replacement for the Rifleman BattleMech. While it was unsuccessful in supplanting the Rifleman, over time the Quickdraw proved itself to be a good generalist 'Mech. Packing excellent firepower, solid armor protection and above-average speed, it quickly earned the respect of many MechWarriors and status as a workhorse in every Successor State's military.

Обладая превосходной огневой мощью, прочной броней и скоростью выше средней, он быстро завоевал уважение многих мехвоинов и статус рабочей лошадки в армии каждого государства-наследника.

content.original:
Based on specs from Operation Trapdoor, the 45 ton Rattlesnake II is a 10 ton upgrade of the original Rattlesnake Mech. Built by Clan Sea Fox for the AFFS during the waning years of the Dark Age, the RSN-1 is powered by a 315-rated Clan XL Engine. 8 tons of Clan Ferro-Fibrous armor and a Guardian ECM suite protect the Mech while Clan MASC increases the Mechs ground speed. A pair of Clan ER Medium Lasers backed up a quartet of Medium Lasers form the bulk of the Mechs arsenal with an ER Small Laser rounding out the weapons. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Пара средних ER-лазеров, подкреплённых квартетом средних лазеров, составляют основу арсенала меха, а малый ER-лазер его завершает. Особенность: Прочный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.03

content.original: The Rawhide is a medium BattleMech built by Kaiser Systems. It shares many similarities to the Scourge heavy BattleMech, and these similarities are more than superficial. In fact, some parts of the Rawhide come from a failed Scourge prototype. [3] Aside from the armor and actuator enhancement system, the Rawhide is constructed of fairly standard and common parts. While some may call this design choice a detriment, it is in fact an advantage on the combat and marketing battlefields, where ease of maintenance and lower costs make the Rawhide attractive to the mercenary market.

content.original: The Razorback is a design that excels at little, but is similarly deficient in few areas. Though the design is rather slow for a 'Mech of its size, it is rarely the slowest 'Mech on the field, either. Because of the 'Mech's general reliance on ballistic and missile weaponry, it does not have to worry about overheating under normal circumstances but is dependent on supply trains. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Хотя и довольно медленный для мехов такого размера, он редко бывает самый медленным на поле боя. Из-за того, что мех в основном использует баллистическое и ракетное оружие, ему не приходится беспокоиться о перегреве в обычных условиях, но он зависим от подвоза боеприпасов.

content.original: The Regent was born when Coventry Metal Works, the designers of the Hauptmann, managed to secure construction rights for an updated version of the original design after help by the ilKhanate. The efficiency of Clan technology meant that the Hauptmann could be replicated on a lighter chassis. Coventry technicians revised their schematics to employ the more readily available 270-rated engine and Clan heat sinks. The 'Mech shed five tons and a significant amount in production costs. Many MechWarriors refer to the resulting product as the Awesomann, a ridiculous yet accurate nickname for the imposing 'Mech, leading pilots of alternate configurations to call their rides Fafnirmann, Maulermann, and others.

content.original: The recent IIC 9 is a quixotic effort. In some regards it embraces the anti-air role, with an enhanced targeting suite. Coolant pods deal with intermittent heat spikes resulting from periods of intense fire amid the relative calm experienced by anti-air units. However, the choice of reflective armor is an odd one. It offers superb protection against the common strafing attack, but in turn increases the vulnerability to equally common bomb strikes. Time will tell if pilots find the trade-off worthwhile. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Sagittaire is built to fight in the confines of an urban battlefield. Weighing in at a massive ninety-five tons, the Sagittaire started production in mid-3063 and began to trickle out to units clamoring for close combat 'Mechs in the midst of the FedCom Civil War. As a power source, the 'Mech has a 285 XL engine. The XL engine saves weight at the cost of survivability and gives the 'Mech a top speed of 54.0 km/h while its mobility is enhanced with three jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters.

content.original: The Sagittaire is built to fight in the confines of an urban battlefield. Weighing in at a massive ninety-five tons, the Sagittaire started production in mid-3063 and began to trickle out to units clamoring for close combat 'Mechs in the midst of the FedCom Civil War. As a power source, the 'Mech has a 285 XL engine. The XL engine saves weight at the cost of survivability and gives the 'Mech a top speed of 54.0 km/h while its mobility is enhanced with three jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters.

content.original: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1BR is powered by a 330-rated Light Fusion Engine giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. An ER PPC and a Streak SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load. MASC provides improved speed for short periods. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
