Несмотря на то, что большинство мехвоинов избегали его из-за его известной нестабильности, Scorpion тем не менее использовался без перерыва на протяжении всех Наследных войн и после них. Scorpion 1BR оснащён лёгким термоядерным двигателем рейтинга 330, который обеспечивает максимальную скорость 97 км/ч. Боевая нагрузка меха включает в себя ER PPC и Streak SRM-6. Система MASC обеспечивает кратковременное увеличение скорости. Особенность: Ул. система жизнеобеспечения Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The WF1 model of the Scourge is powered by a 325-rated fusion engine, which allows this heavy 'Mech the speed to engage moderately-swift combat units. The 'Mech's four Jump Jets gives it the tactical flexibility to outmaneuver many units that it can't outpace. Protecting its vital components during battle, the 'Mech's hull is fitted with 12.5 tons of light ferro-fibrous armor. The Scourge's main weapon is an Gauss rifle, located in its left arm. This weapon is limited to sixteen rounds of ammunition. The bulk of its close-in firepower comes from four ER medium lasers in the right arm, and a single medium pulse laser located in the left arm. The array of ER medium lasers found in the 'Mech's right arm uses an advanced tech actuator enhancement system to allow the weapons better accuracy. content.original: The Shogun began production before the Star League fell and eventually was thought to be lost to the Succession Wars. The 'Mech suddenly reappeared when Wolf's Dragoons showed up in 3005, bringing a sizable number of Shoguns with them. The 'Mech was intended to be used as an urban combat 'Mech where its jumping distance and slow speed makes it able to easily traverse the close confines of a city. Though the Dragoons brought Shoguns with them from the Clan Homeworlds, they could not reach a deal with any manufacturer that met their desires, so by 3068 the total count of the 'Mech in the Inner Sphere was reduced to two, both of which were in the hands of Wannamaker's Widowmakers, taken as salvage from the Dragoons.

content.content: Производство «Сёгуна» началось ещё до падения Звёздной Лиги, и в конечном итоге все посчитали, что мех был утерян в Наследных войнах. Мех внезапно появился вновь с появлением Волчьих Драгун в 3005 году, приведя с собой значительное количество «Сёгунов». Мех предназначался для использования в качестве городского боевого меха, где его дальность прыжка и низкая скорость позволяли ему легко пересекать тесные городские границы. Хотя Драгуны привезли с собой «Сёгунов» из родных миров Кланов, им не удалось заключить сделку ни с одним производителем, который бы отвечал их требованиям, поэтому к 3068 году общее количество этих мехов во Внутренней Сфере сократилось до двух, оба из которых оказались в руках Wannamaker's Widowmakers, отнятых у Драгун.

content.original: The new Shogun C 3 is firmly aimed at tradition-minded Clan customers. Marketed for the same niche as the old Warhawk, which still captures the minds and hearts of so many, the new Shogun increases speed at the cost of the enormous short-range damage potential of earlier variants. There are few complaints, as the C 3 may be the most balanced Shogun to date. The new Artemis V FCS and the PPC capacitor forced a replacement of the venerable original HartfordCo targeting system with a far more modern and advanced one. The new targeting solution is amongst the best available, and is one of the reasons behind the success of this new variant. Despite carrying seven tons of ammunition, the 'Mech is surprisingly tough, thanks to CASE II. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: A prototype OmniMech built on the success of the Stormcrow line, fielded by Clan Wolf for trials before going into full production. Using a combination of a 330-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine and TSM, the 'Mech is able to achieve speeds up to 110 km/h. Perhaps the most startling innovation included in this design is the Clan Interface Armor, which allows a MechWarrior to interface with their 'Mech while being completely armored should they be forced to eject. This combination interface allows the Ryoken III pilot's a degree of control in combat, and removes the need to have a Gyro mounted in the 'Mech. This technology was thought to have been lost at the time of Skinwalker's baptism in combat by Inner Sphere powers. In addition to having its pilot encased in a power-armor interface, the Mech's hull is protected by 11.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor Armor.

content.content: Прототип омнимеха, созданный на основе успешной линейки Stormcrow, использовался кланом Волка для испытаний перед запуском в производство. Используя комбинацию сверхлегкого термоядерного двигателя рейтинга 330 и TSM, этот омнимех способен развивать скорость до 110 км/ч. Пожалуй, самым поразительным новшеством в этой конструкции является клановая интерфейсная броня, которая позволяет мехвоину взаимодействовать со своим мехом и при этом быть полностью бронированным в своей кабине. Этот интерфейс позволяет пилоту Ryoken III контролировать ситуацию в бою и избавляет его от необходимости устанавливать гироскоп на меха. Считалось, что эта технология была утеряна во время боевого крещения Skinwalker против сил Внутренней Сферы. Помимо того, что пилот окружён усиленной бронёй, корпус меха защищен 11,5 тоннами ферро-ламеллярной брони.

content.original: A prototype OmniMech built on the success of the Stormcrow line, fielded by Clan Wolf for trials before going into full production. Using a combination of a 330-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine and TSM, the 'Mech is able to achieve speeds up to 110 km/h. Perhaps the most startling innovation included in this design is the Clan Interface Armor, which allows a MechWarrior to interface with their 'Mech while being completely armored should they be forced to eject. This combination interface allows the Ryoken III pilot's a degree of control in combat, and removes the need to have a Gyro mounted in the 'Mech. This technology was thought to have been lost at the time of Skinwalker's baptism in combat by Inner Sphere powers. In addition to having its pilot encased in a power-armor interface, the Mech's hull is protected by 11.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor Armor.

content.content: Прототип омнимеха, созданный на основе успешной линейки Stormcrow, использовался кланом Волка для испытаний перед запуском в производство. Используя комбинацию сверхлегкого термоядерного двигателя рейтинга 330 и TSM, этот омнимех способен развивать скорость до 110 км/ч. Пожалуй, самым поразительным новшеством в этой конструкции является клановая интерфейсная броня, которая позволяет мехвоину взаимодействовать со своим мехом и при этом быть полностью бронированным в своей кабине. Этот интерфейс позволяет пилоту Ryoken III контролировать ситуацию в бою и избавляет его от необходимости устанавливать гироскоп на меха. Считалось, что эта технология была утеряна во время боевого крещения Skinwalker против сил Внутренней Сферы. Помимо того, что пилот окружён усиленной бронёй, корпус меха защищен 11,5 тоннами ферро-ламеллярной брони.

content.original: The Sojourner is a simple 'Mech designed by Clan Wolf-in-Exile after the staggering loss at Arc-Royal. The 'Mech went through several design phases resulting in a final design that was both easy to maintain and pilot, with the primary use being to teach younger MechWarriors the trade of 'Mech-on-'Mech combat. As a result the pilots of these 'Mechs have a considerably higher survival rate compared to other, harder to pilot 'Mechs like the Linebacker. The base variant of the Sojourner carries a Gauss Rifle, with the compliment of a single ER Large Laser and a Plasma Cannon. The combination of 3 Jump Jets, a Supercharger and an AES system makes the 'Mech quite mobile on the battlefield despite its somewhat underpowered 240-rated Fusion Core. A CASE II system and a single external Double Heat Sink finishes up the design. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Based on the original Star League-era BattleMech, the Stalker II is a complete top-to-bottom redesign that takes advantage of technological advancements gained since the last era of open warfare ended. These efforts resulted in the Stalker II, giving troops an incredibly durable assault 'Mech that is able to withstand horrific amounts of punishment while keeping the original Stalker's success, which was it's variants that used Star League-era fire control systems. In order to recapture this particular aspect of the old design, the Stalker II was fitted with a modern Targeting Computer. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Irian developed a new variant of its classic Stalker after its latest 'Mech, the Stalker II, was snubbed by some customers due to it's limited weapon flexibility. The -9F keeps the Stalker II's hardened armor, and Irian addressed concerns regarding damage output on the modern battlefield by making its primary weapons Clan grade. Irian could supply equivalent large pulse lasers to augment the traditional Magna medium lasers. They negotiated a deal with Skate Khanate's Beta Aimag for missile launchers and sensors in return for a percentage of the production output. The STK-9F's combination of durability and destructive potential made it a common sight in this region of the Inner Sphere. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

The Scorpion Empire employs the ’Mech in groups, enhancing the threat through numbers rather than via armament. Though their current numbers remain low, an unverified report indicates Star Pythons are being deployed in Trinary-sized hunting packs. The combined might of many light ’Mechs delivers through synergy what each lacks individually. It doubles as a fast scout, combining excellent speed with limited jump capability. content.original: Needing to build up its forces after establishing the Wolf Empire and wanting a more generalist unit than the Skinwalker, Clan Wolf's Ramiel Bekker created the Stormwolf in collaboration with Clan Sea Fox by modifying the Wendigo to the Clan's exacting specifications. The 'Mech was designed with the intention of striking a balance between firepower and speed, and chief among Bekker's modifications was the addition of fixed mobility-enhancing equipment in order to shape the 'Mech's role in combat, as well as relocating the 'Mech's cockpit to the head. This relocation's associated visual changes gave the 'Mech a more canid or ursid appearance, bringing it more in line with the earlier Wulfen and Warwolf aesthetically.

content.original: Needing to build up its forces after establishing the Wolf Empire and wanting a more generalist unit than the Skinwalker, Clan Wolf's Ramiel Bekker created the Stormwolf in collaboration with Clan Sea Fox by modifying the Wendigo to the Clan's exacting specifications. The 'Mech was designed with the intention of striking a balance between firepower and speed, and chief among Bekker's modifications was the addition of fixed mobility-enhancing equipment in order to shape the 'Mech's role in combat, as well as relocating the 'Mech's cockpit to the head. This relocation's associated visual changes gave the 'Mech a more canid or ursid appearance, bringing it more in line with the earlier Wulfen and Warwolf aesthetically.

content.original: The Striker was originally commissioned by the SLDF high command in 2571 for non-Royal SLDF units. Along with the Stalker, the Striker became one of the most common 'Mechs in service. The Striker was built with the intent of being rugged and reliable, but more importantly, allowed House Lords to reserve their precious and limited numbers of assault BattleMechs for their own personal armies. In this way, the Striker may have been the show of good faith the House Lords needed to make the Star League work. In spite of the 'Mech's dependability, the Striker was marginal compared with later assault BattleMechs, and was eventually relegated to serving in militia units, with the highest concentration ending up on the rimward edge of the Terran Hegemony. After the destruction of the Stormvanger lines in 2867, fewer than 300 Strikers were known to exist in 3058

content.original: Hey Boss, the clans call these things the Summoner but I've always called em' the Thor.  These OmniMechs are a tad light on available pod space for their weight class and those early structural mounts are not compatible with anything else. But with that huge engine and lots of jumpjet hardpoints you will be hard pressed to find many 'Mechs its size that are faster.

content.original: A second-line Clan 'Mech feared by many Inner Sphere pilots, the Supernova seems to be an advanced version of the Black Hawk, though it was actually developed before that venerable OmniMech. Plans to replace the King Crab's loadout with clusters of Large Lasers grew from a shortage of autocannon ammunition. The first prototypes met with little success due to the King Crab's integral Ferro-fibrous armor, but gave rise to a lighter and leaner new design which eventually became the Supernova.

content.original: The Swordsman was an early Federated Suns medium-class BattleMech which was originally built in 2463 as House Davion's third in-house BattleMech design. The design was tainted by heavy use in the Davion Civil War of 2525-2540. Eventually, production ended and the design was relegated to the dustbin of history. However, in the 3060s, the mech was put back into production by House Davion to supplement their forces in the FedCom Civil War. The SWD-2 is the stock production design, mounting heavy armor and firepower for the tonnage: 7.5 tons of armor and a grab-bag mix of guns including an AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, two Medium Lasers, and a Small Laser. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.content: «Мечник» был ранним боевым мехом среднего класса Федеративных Солнц, который был первоначально построен в 2463 году как третий собственный дизайн боевого меха Дома Дэвион. Конструкция была испорчена интенсивным использованием в Гражданской войне Дэвиона 2525-2540 годов. В конце концов, производство было прекращено, и проект был отправлен на свалку истории. Однако в 3060-х годах мех был снова запущен в производство Домом Дэвион для пополнения своих сил в Гражданской войне ФедСода. SWD-2 является стоковой моделью, несущей тяжелую броню и огневую мощь для тоннажа: 7,5 тонн брони и подборку орудий, включая AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, два средних лазера и малый лазер. Особенность: Встроенный прожектор Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.02

content.original: The Swordsman was an early Federated Suns medium-class BattleMech which was originally built in 2463 as House Davion's third in-house BattleMech design. The design was tainted by heavy use in the Davion Civil War of 2525-2540. Eventually, production ended and the design was relegated to the dustbin of history. However, in the 3060s, the mech was put back into production by House Davion to supplement their forces in the FedCom Civil War. The SWD-2 is the stock production design, mounting heavy armor and firepower for the tonnage: 7.5 tons of armor and a grab-bag mix of guns including an AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, two Medium Lasers, and a Small Laser.

content.content: «Мечник» был ранним боевым мехом среднего класса Федеративных Солнц, который был первоначально построен в 2463 году как третий собственный дизайн боевого меха Дома Дэвион. Конструкция была испорчена интенсивным использованием в Гражданской войне Дэвиона 2525-2540 годов. В конце концов, производство было прекращено, и проект был отправлен на свалку истории. Однако в 3060-х годах мех был снова запущен в производство Домом Дэвион для пополнения своих сил в Гражданской войне ФедСода. SWD-2 является стоковой моделью, несущей тяжелую броню и огневую мощь для тоннажа: 7,5 тонн брони и подборку орудий, включая AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, два средних лазера и малый лазер.

content.original: The 'Mech features a 300-rated XL engine with MASC and a Supercharger, allowing it to reach high speeds normally found on lighter machines. Enhancing its mobility further are five jump jets, giving it a jump capacity of 150 meters. The Thresher Mk II's armament features a mix of long range and short range options. Its main battery of guns consists of an ER PPC with a LRM-15, supplied with two tons of ammunition. At shorter ranges, a large pulse laser coupled with a SRM-4 and flamer are available for use. Its ammunition is protected by CASE II, greatly decreasing damage to the right torso from ammo explosions and allowing the XL engine to continue operating with little fear of damage. Clan Sea Fox chose to protect the 'Mech with 9.5 tons of Gamma Special Reflective armor. This armor gives the 'Mech resistance to energy weapons, but makes it more vulnerable to artillery and some ballistic weapons. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Thresher Mk II is a Heavy Clan BattleMech designed as a skirmisher by Clan Sea Fox. This is a remodeled/refitted version of the venerable Thresher. The Thresher Mk II came about when a number of these 'Mechs were produced during the Dark Age Era and Clan Sea Fox Merchants were unable to sell them. Negotiations with Clan Wolf Khan Alaric Ward paved the way toward a sale, but only if the 'Mechs were refitted to Clan Wolf's specifications, which included arm actuators that the original design never featured.

An engine Supercharger can combine with heat activated Triple Strength Myomer to sprint at speeds of 108 km/h. Twelve double heat sinks are carried, and the Endo Steel chassis is protected by twenty tons of Ballistic Reinforced Armor. The right torso carries two tons of missile ammunition in a CASE II protected bay. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

Replacing the LRMs are a Gauss Rifle, a Large Pulse Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and an ER Large Laser. An XL engine and a half-ton armor reduction allows room for this armament array and jump jets. content.original: Clan Hell's Horses originally conceived of the Thunder Stallion as a totem 'Mech, along the lines of the Mandrill. After the poor performance of other totem designs, however, that aspect was downplayed to the point that only the rear legs retain any of the equine aesthetic styling that was supposed to be such an important aspect of the 'Mech. True to the emphasis on combined arms warfare that the Horses value, the Thunder Stallion is an assault 'Mech that is designed to support what would be considered secondary forces in any other Clan. Since it was designed to work with infantry, the Thunder Stallion's top speed of 54 km/h is roughly equivalent to the speed that an Elemental Battle Armor can move.

content.original: Produced in 2546, the Toro was the Taurian Concordant’s first battlemech design. Based on captured Firebees, the Toro is a long range support mech. Armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-5s the Toro carried two tons of ammo and 10 single heat sinks. The last Toro factory was demolished in 2598 by invading Star League troops and production would not resume until the Word of Blake Jihad. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.

content.original: One of the few joint GM/Blackwell product lines salvaged after the Jihad, GM put the Victor back into production in the early 3080s. The current -12D variant utilizes the endo-steel frame and light engine of some predecessors. It also shares a number of components and weapons with the Templar III. A targeting computer improves the Gauss rifle’s accuracy, while a heavy-duty gyro and CASE II improve its durability. The simplicity of this variant enables it to be supplied as a refit kit for various earlier models. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Recently deployed in considerable numbers in the CCAF, the Vindicator -7L returns the 'Mech to its rugged, generalist nature. While most of the package remains unchanged, Ferro-Fibrous armor increases protection for less weight, while a reinforced chassis and CASE II greatly improve durability. The biggest surprise is the addition of a Clan Kingston ER PPC, supplied by Skate Khanate. The Capellans adapted it to work with the Vindicator's simple but effective cooling jacket. Now longer-ranged, harder-hitting, and possessing greater endurance, the -7L has proven to be a deadly combatant in the Capellan March and along the Free Worlds border. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Vindicator is one of the most well-known Capellan Confederation BattleMechs. This workhorse of the CCAF was originally built in 2826 between the First and Second Succession War to maximize the effectiveness of the Confederation's surviving production capabilities and fulfill as many roles as possible. Designed by committee, the Vindicator's 'jack-of-all-trades' nature means it does not excel in any one role but fulfills them adequately. With almost all of its components produced on Capella, the Vindicator is also cheap, easy to mass produce, and quick to repair with a ready supply of spare parts.

content.original: Almost 300 years after its original creation, the Viper was reborn in the Republic era. But not because of demand for a forgotten unit, but because a stockpile of blazers was discovered in a Kallon warehouse in 3123. Kallon engineers were then developing a new 'Mech for the RAF. They, like their predecessors, realized that the Viper was ideal for the surplus weapons. Viper schematics survived in their database, and existing Crusader tooling could be readily adapted.

content.original: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This version uses an XXL Engine to reach top speeds of 86 km/h. Its weapon load hearkens back to the original Warhammer, carrying ER PPCs in the arms and a single ER Medium Laser and ER Small Laser in the left and right torso. An SRM-6 is also carried in the right torso, and an ECM Suite disrupts enemy communications and targeting. This version is protected by Heat-Dissipating Armor. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Оригинальный Warhammer был разработан как штурмовой боевой мех. Однако он был вытеснен более поздними и более тяжёлыми мехами, хотя и оставался мощной оружейной платформой. Кланы благоразумно сохранили и построили на этой прочной раме настоящий штурмовой мех — Warhammer IIC. Эта версия оснащена двигателем XXL, позволяющим развивать максимальную скорость 86 км/ч. Вооружение соответствует оригинальному Warhammer: в руках установлены ER PPC, а в левом и правом торсе — один ER Medium Laser и один ER Small Laser. В правом торсе также установлена SRM-6, а система РЭБ нарушает связь и наведение противника. Эта версия защищена теплорассеивающей броней. Особенность: Встроенный прожектор Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.2 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 280-rated Light Engine and armored in Ballistic Reinforced armor, the Warhammer WHM-10K is armed with a pair of ER PPCs. Paired Medium Lasers, ER Small Lasers, Clan Machine Guns and a Streak SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. Clan DHS and CASE II round out the design. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The War Crow is a Heavy OmniMech fielded by Clan Snow Raven. Commissioned by Khan Sterling McKenna, she had implemented development of the War Crow as a part of efforts to prepare her Clan for a war she believed could end up coming to the Alliance. The War Crow was designed to become the backbone of a newly revived Touman of Clan Snow Raven. Powered by the Redline 350 Extra-Light Fusion Engine, the War Crow is designed to move at a modest pace with other combatants. The Snow Raven Scientist caste designed the 'Mech with the latest in their Clan's armor protection, 15.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor. While still a heavy OmniMech, the Ravens chose to give the Mech a fully functional hand actuator in the right arm.

content.original: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech.

content.original: The Xanthos was first introduced by the Capellan Confederation in 2564, designed by a young engineer named Dr. David Harrison. Working for Hollis Inc., he pioneered the technology to create four-legged BattleMechs. This technological advancement that later allowed the research into the Scorpion and Goliath enabled the Xanthos to get on the field. It was presented to the Terran Hegemony for review after the cancellation of the Catapult. Hollis pushed to have this 'Mech presented against Dr. Harrison's wishes in a bid to maintain financial solvency. Clumsy and stiff, the 'Mech failed to win the contract from the Star League purchasing committee.

content.original: The Laser Bellona was massively upgraded with an XL engine, armored motive system, Streak LRMs, and a targeting computer This update gives Support Cizins a run for their money. In the late 3060s, under Khan James Cobb's command, Clan Hell's Horses began preparation for a renewed presence in the Inner Sphere. The scientist caste saw this as an opportunity to create a new cavalry vehicle, which they called the Bellona. Designed as a striker and flanker, the Bellona carries enough firepower on a nimble enough frame to keep up with even the fastest-advancing lines. The original specs called for tracks, but test pilots for the vehicle cited that 'speed is armor', which led to the Bellona being redesigned as a hovertank. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: Despite the original being introduced in 2564 updated Condors are still in production as of the start of the 32nd Century. Substantial armor of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit designed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover tanks available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest vehicles in its weight class. Biome Restrictions: None. Солидная броня весом не менее шести тонн и различные комплексы вооружения средней и большой дальности делают Condor по-прежнему актуальным. «Кондор» — тяжелый кавалерийский юнит, предназначенный для быстрого реагирования на изменения в ходе боя, был одним из немногих тяжелых ховер-танков, доступных на момент его появления. Этот огромный танк способен развивать скорость до 129 км/ч и крейсерскую скорость 86 км/ч, что делает его одним из самых быстрых транспортных средств в своей весовой категории. content.original: A light combat vehicle that first saw production in 2692 the Galleon proved to be an economical means of supporting infantry and BattleMechs. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. Обладая максимальной скоростью, превышающей скорость большинства мехов, Galleon был мобилен, но не имел достаточной защиты: ранние модели несли всего три с половиной тонны брони. После Исхода эти гусеничные машины попали в основном в распоряжение Синдиката Дракона и Лиги Свободных Миров. Galleon часто используется в паре с ракетной платформой Harasser. Ограничения биома: нет. content.original: The newest member of the Ontos family, Grumman Amalgamated's Chemical Laser Ontos is possibly the deadliest Ontos to date. Produced in the Wolf Empire with the aid of Free Guild and Wolf Merchant Caste investments, the Ontos (Chemical) does away with the need for the heat sinks that crippled the traditional Ontos models. Exchanging the standard ICE or Fusion Engine for an XL Engine and armouring the tank in Ferro-Fibrous armor frees up the weight needed to mount 8 Large Chemical Lasers in the turret whilst retaining the standard LRM-5's. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.original: This version of the Padilla introduced in 3134, replaces the standard Padilla weaponry with a Gauss rifle tied into a Targeting Computer. Not to be confused with the original Padilla, the Padilla Tube Artillery Tank was a Republic of the Sphere vehicle meant to fulfill a similar role. Originally designed and produced by Aldis Industries at the request of Precentor Martial Cameron St. Jamais, the Padilla Tube Artillery Tank serves as the main conventional artillery support platform used by the Republic Armed Forces. The Padilla is well-protected for a vehicle of its size. This is good as the tank's low top speed could make it an easy target for fast moving units or airstrikes. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: First appearing in 3056, the Palisade Defense Tank is a 60-ton defensive tank found throughout the wealthier parts of the Periphery. Based on an older tank design dating back to the Succession Wars, the Palisade is designed as a multi-role tank capable of engaging Mechs or Vehicles. Capable of speeds of 60 km/h, the Palisade (Streak LRM) is powered by a 240-rated Fuel Cell and carries 11.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The main gun is an LB-10X, with a Clan SLRM-15 supporting this at longer ranges. An MG provides some limited anti-infantry capabilities and CASE mitigates crew danger should an ammo explosion happen. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.original: Unveiled in 3110 the Partisan AA Vehicle, a lighter take on the original Partisan Air Defense Tank, was meant to be cheaper and faster but still be equally effective in the anti-aircraft role. Produced in 3134, this version of the Partisan AA would give the vehicle a longer reach than before, while gaining secondary weaponry which the Standard Model lacked. Gone is the standard LB-5X Class autocannons, in their place are a pair of Class 2 Hypervelocity Autocannons. Though lacking the punch of the Standard's bigger LB-5Xs, the HVAC/2s accuracy is improved by adding a Targeting Computer to the vehicle. As a secondary weapon, the vehicle is fitted with a 10-tubed Rocket Launcher in the turret. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. content.original: The Saladin Mk II HCV is a redesigned version of the original Third Succession War-era Saladin combat vehicle prized for its hitting power and speed. This new version of the Scarborough Manufacturers' famous line of hovercrafts would be first produced during the mid-thirty-second century. While retaining the speed of the original model, the Saladin MK II is considerably better protected by Scarborough engineers using 5.5 tons of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor. The tank's primary weapon is its front-mounted Magna Flarestar Snub-Nose Particle Projection Cannon. While this has less punch than the original's heavy Autocannon, the PPC has no ammunition needs, allowing it to keep fighting longer and at greater ranges. Biome Restrictions: None. content.content: «Саладин Mk II HCV» — это переработанная версия оригинальной боевой машины «Саладин» времён Третьей Наследной, ценившейся за свою боевую мощь и скорость. Эта новая версия знаменитой линейки машин на воздушной подушке от Scarborough Manufacturers впервые была выпущена в середине 32 века. Сохраняя скорость оригинальной модели, Saladin MK II значительно лучше защищён инженерами Scarborough, используя 5,5 тонн тяжёлой ферроволоконной брони. Основное оружие танка — фронтальная пушка Magna Flarestar Snub-Nose Particle Projection Cannon. Хотя её мощность меньше, чем у тяжёлой автопушки оригинала, зато PPC не нуждается в боеприпасах, что позволяет вести бой дольше и на больших дистанциях. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 10/15 гексов / 300/450 метров. Броня: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Структура: Structure Знач-я Б С Перед 245 20 Лево 120 20 Право 120 20 Зад 90 20 Итого 575 80 Особенность: Шустрый

content.original: The SM Tank Destroyer was designed as a speedy infighter by scientists from Clan Nova Cat. The machine is a cheap and effective combat vehicle. The vehicle has unique 'glass' dual cockpits on the front of the vehicle that are functionally identical while mounting a smaller anti-infantry turret just behind its left side cockpit. content.original: The Arion, developed by Clan Hell's Horses, is a versatile hybrid combat unit designed for both BattleMech and tank configurations. Equipped with an ER Large Laser and two SRM-4 launchers, the Arion is capable of delivering devastating firepower at medium to long ranges. With a top speed of 97 km/h, it can rapidly traverse the battlefield and reposition as needed. The Arion's conversion capability allows it to operate as either a fast, heavily armed BattleMech or a heavily armored tank with a low profile, depending on the mission's needs. In BattleMech mode, the Arion is capable of agile and dynamic movements, thanks to its quadrupedal design. When converted to a tank, the Arion provides an armored, low-profile platform with a powerful punch. Despite its versatility, the Arion is not as heavily armored as traditional BattleMechs, and its conversion process takes time and resources, making it less effective in rapidly changing combat situations. Nevertheless, its ability to perform in multiple roles makes it a valuable asset in a wide range of missions. Quirk: QuadVee Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

However, this increase in firepower comes at a cost, as the heat buildup from firing both lasers simultaneously can quickly overtax the mech's heat management systems. To mitigate this, four additional Laser Heat Sinks are added to the configuration, allowing the Boreas to maintain its firepower for longer periods of time before needing to cool down. This configuration is ideal for situations where overwhelming firepower is necessary, but care must be taken to avoid overheating the mech. Особенность: QuadVee Mech Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.09

content.original: The Boreas Prime is an OmniMech and QuadVee hybrid designed and produced by Clan Hell's Horses. Armed with an ER PPC, Medium Pulse Laser, and Streak SRM-6, it is well-suited for mid-to-long range combat engagements. With a top speed of 64 km/h, it is capable of quickly maneuvering around the battlefield. Its OmniMech design allows for modular customization, making it a versatile platform for any mission. It is a potent combatant in the hands of a skilled pilot. Its QuadVee hybrid design provides additional stability and mobility, making it suitable for rough terrain. Quirk: QuadVee Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The C configuration carries an ATM-6 in the left arm, an ER Large Laser in the right arm, and a Plasma Cannon in the right torso. The missile launcher and plasma cannon each have two tons of ammo. Additional protection is provided by an ECM Suite to jam enemy C3 networks. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: After the DVS-10 was met quite unfavourably by the AFFS, Corean fell under severe pressure to bring back the original Devastator and its powerful punch. However, they instead reworked the assault 'Mech once more. The resulting DVS-11 is the compromise no one knew they needed. Nearly as fast as the -10, the return of the classic weaponry—dual Gauss rifles and a PPC—allows this Devastator to tangle with the toughest of Atlases or Stalkers. It is regarded as a premier line-breaker, and its swift sales have prompted Norse-Storm executives to approach Corean for a licensing agreement. content.original: The ENF-5R is relatively low-tech compared to the Enforcer III. It can be constructed quickly and in large numbers by the reborn Kallon Industries lines following the loss of New Avalon. The LB 10-X is easily produced, while the large reengineered laser counters some of the newer armors of modern battlefields. Although slower than the Enforcer III, its light engine is more durable, and with the addition of CASE II the -5R can stay in the field longer. As with earlier models, the size of the head-mounted sensor pod varies, depending on which targeting system is installed. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

The weaponry is mildly upgraded from the original armament. The FFL-5A's most notable improvements are however its increased engine size and the additional functionality of its partial wings - mostly cosmetic in prior models. This addressed one of the chief criticisms of the Firefly: poor mobility for a light 'Mech. The FFL-5A Firefly has reclaimed its status as one of the Dragoons' primary light combat units, which will undoubtedly make it an attractive purchase for other mercenary commands Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

The right arm carries an Inner Sphere-produced plasma rifle fed by two tons of ammunition, while a plasma cannon mounted in the right torso and fed by one ton of ammunition provides additional power. Seven improved jump jets let the 'Mech cover 210 meters in a jump. Protection is provided by nine tons of ferro-fibrous armor. content.original: Designed as a close combat skirmisher the Gargoyle J also has impressive maneuverability. Seven torso mounted Improved Jump Jets give the 'Mech a 210 meter jump range. This, along with its 86 km/h top speed, allows the 'Mech to easily bring its close range laser batteries into range. The heavy firepower of four Improved Heavy Medium Lasers fires from the right arm, while a brace of seven ER Small Lasers fires from the left. These weapons allow the J to eviscerate a foe’s armor up close, but leaves the J helpless at longer ranges and forces it to rely on its maneuverability to avoid enemy fire as it closes. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Following on the heels of the Jade Falcon’s adoption of physical attacks, the Gargoyle K represents a paradigm shift in tactics of other Clans. Mounting a six ton Hatchet in its right arm the Gargoyle K is the first Clan 'Mech so equipped. Adding to the danger of the hatchet is a Supercharger that allows the K to run at over 100 km/h, a staggering speed for an assault 'Mech. Focused solely on short range destruction, the K's other weapons are for use up close. Each of the 'Mech’s torsos comes equipped with a Streak SRM-4 launcher. All three launchers are fed by a single ton of ammo in the CASE II protected left torso. Four Improved Heavy Medium Lasers reside in the left arm. To ensure no targets can hide from the K an Active Probe is housed in the right torso. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Developed as a complement to the Griffin in the later years of the Jihad, the Ghost is a medium strike 'Mech that saw considerable use in the years after the formation of the Republic of the Sphere. Developed by the Lyran Commonwealth and elements of the former Free Worlds League the Ghost carries an extensive array of electronic warfare equipment into combat. A Beagle Active Probe allows the Ghost to find enemy units, while Stealth Armor and a Guardian ECM Suite allows the 'Mech to live up to its name. With excellent land speed and formidable medium-range weaponry, the Ghost is ideal for hunter-killer and heavy raiding missions, especially when paired with Griffins.Another variant introduced in 3133 removes the SRM-6 rack from the standard Dark Age Ghost and replaces it with a Chainsaw to minimize logistical needs, or potentially to disguise it as an IndustrialMech. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The complex actuator design and the lack of credible defensive weaponry leaves the Goliath open to close-range attacks and battle armor swarms. Osaka Heavy Metrics’ recently introduced GOL-7K has a deadly counter to such threats: M-pods concealed in the center torso and in each leg. These defenses are hidden behind blow-away panels designed to resemble maintenance hatches, providing an unwelcome surprise for anyone who gets too close. With a focus on mediumrange combat, this Goliath variant is part of their expansion to add a true BattleMech to their stable of combat support quad IndustrialMechs. How and when Osaka acquired the plans is unknown, but espionage is suspected. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: The Götterdämmerung is a Heavy class BattleMech first fielded by the Lyran Commonwealth in 3138, the 'Mech's German name translates to twilight of the gods or ragnarök. The Götterdämmerung's durability is due in part of layers of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor, while Blackstone would move the cockpit of the 'Mech to the torso. The Torso-Mounted Cockpit's ejection system is highly complex, making escape from the Götterdämmerung difficult under certain circumstances. MechWarriors piloting the 'Mech need also be wary of losing their side torsos, due to the split placement of their life support systems. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: Founded in 3132, Jötunn BattleWorx's one purpose was the local development of reinforced chassis technology in a workable BattleMech. Flush with Bear-Krona thanks to Gray Monday appropriations, Jötunn took an old Grizzly and rebuilt it. The Bruin’s superior durability and similar armament had relegated the Grizzly to obsolescence decades earlier. Four years of testing saw endless permutations of weapons to find the ideal combatant. To allocate mass lost to the chassis, the sturdy old reactor was replaced with an XL model with no loss in resilience, proving the concept. Its arsenal remained largely the same, though a Plasma rifle replaced the Gauss rifle and targeting was improved for all weapons. The Grizzly that marched off Jötunn’s first production line in 3138 was highly compromised, but the lessons learned informed the development of a new generation of OmniMechs Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Harpagos is a Clan Hell's Horses' heavy BattleMech designed for long-range combat. Armed with two Gauss rifles, the Harpagos can deliver devastating pinpoint damage at extreme ranges. While lacking jump jets, it boasts a top speed of 64 km/h, enabling it to reposition and maintain distance from its enemies. Its armor is also thick enough to withstand enemy attacks, making it a formidable opponent on the battlefield. However, the Harpagos has a large profile and is relatively slow compared to other heavy BattleMechs. Pilots must use careful positioning and cover to ensure its survival, while making use of its Gauss rifles to strike at enemies from afar. Quirk: QuadVee Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. Using information from captured Daishis and data gleaned from the construction of the Firestarter OmniMech, which was shared by the Draconis Combine, the end result is a powerful OmniMech capable of defending itself in most combat situations. The Hauptmann is built on a standard chassis and powered by a 285 fusion engine, adding to the 'Mech's durability as it cannot be killed by a side torso loss. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. For protection, the Hauptmann carries eighteen and a half tons of armor and has CASE fixed in the right torso to protect against an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

A Beagle Active probe paired with a C3 unit make up the mech's specialist electronics. 4 Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-6s with Artemis IV provide a nasty punch at close range, while a Gauss Rifle covers longer ranges. With the freed weight and space, a Boosted C3 Master computer is mounted in the left torso. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.09

content.original: The Hellion is a product of Clan Ice Hellion and their philosophy that espouses speed above all else. Based on the Mist Lynx, the Hellion is a fast OmniMech that has respectable firepower. This light 'Mech is rather difficult to kill, incorporating five and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. To save weight, the Hellion also uses an Endo Steel chassis. While it is not especially fast for its size, the Hellion does use MASC to allow for bursts of additional speed. The Hellion sports no fixed weapons on its chassis. The T configuration consists of three Medium Pulse Lasers, a LRM-10 launcher and three Streak SRM 2 Improved One Shot launchers. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Хеллион» — творение клана Ледяного Хеллиона и их философии, ставящей скорость превыше всего. Созданный на основе «Мист Линкса», «Хеллион» — это быстрый омнимех с впечатляющей огневой мощью. Этот лёгкий мех довольно сложно уничтожить, так как он оснащён пятью с половиной тоннами ферроволоконной брони. Для снижения веса «Хеллион» также использует эндостальной каркас. Хотя он не особенно быстр для своих размеров, «Хеллион» использует систему MASC, позволяющую ему резко увеличивать скорость. Конфигурация T состоит из трех средних импульсных лазеров, пусковой установки LRM-10 и трех Streak SRM 2. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.98 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The -7A increases prior models' firepower with innovative technologies. A light engine frees up mass to upgrade the base frame. The previously favored heavy PPC is swapped for an AC/10, which provides heavy firepower. Although this may seem a poor trade, the ammunition reliance forces the -7A not to overextend itself. CASE II provides some improved protection to the relatively weak armor, while the pulse laser is upgraded to an X-pulse version. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: When Clan Hell's Horses occupied the site of the W-7 Facilities in 3142, Clan Wolf had not taken everything. The boneyard where Highlanders had been refit to IIC-standard for seventy years was extensive. With the Inner Sphere desperately rearming, spare Highlanders viable for upgrading were a rare commodity, so the Horses improved the line to build the SL-XT chassis while sourcing parts from New Oslo to Alnabog, the latter to our profit. While not quite the same as the ancient Clan 'Mech, the new Highlander IIC 4 proved a formidable package when unleashed in Operation Noyan. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content: Когда в 3142 году клан Адских Лошадей занял территорию объектов W-7, клан Волка вывез не всё. Свалка, где «Горцы» на протяжении семидесяти лет переделывались в IIC, была обширной. В условиях, когда Внутренняя Сфера отчаянно перевооружалась, запасные «Горцы», пригодные для модернизации, были редким товаром, поэтому Лошади усовершенствовали производственную линию для создания шасси SL-XT, поставляя туда детали от Нового Осло до Алнабога. Несмотря на то, что новый Highlander IIC-4 был не похож на предыдущие древние клановские варианты, он оказался грозным дополнением в операции «Ноян». Особенность: Укреплённые ноги Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.2 Лимит приводов рук: Right Lower

content.original: Built by Luthien Armor Works of New Samarkand, the Hitotsume Kozo is a medium BattleMech designed to serve in the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery. This 'Mech's creation was partially influenced by an unofficial cultural rebirth. Keeping this in mind, LAW styled the appearance of the Hitotsume Kozo after the ancient Japanese Bushido armor worn by the samurai warriors during that time period on Terra. It received a poor reception by front-line troops due its advanced features and high heat output; however, it was appreciated when transferred to less-favored combat units, such as Ghost Regiments, as these less-fickle warriors adapted to the design's quirks and turned it into an effective combat unit. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Хитосуне Козо», построенный компанией Luthien Armor Works на Новом Самарканде, представляет собой средний боевой мех, предназначенный для службы в составе мобилизованных солдат Синдиката Дракона. На создание этого меха отчасти повлияло неофициальное культурное возрождение. Учитывая это, LAW стилизовали внешний вид Hitotsume Kozo по образцу древних японских доспехов бусидо, которые носили самураи в тот период на Терре. Он был плохо принят войсками на передовой из-за высокой теплоотдачи и ряда особенностей; однако он был оценен по достоинству при передаче менее популярным боевым подразделениям, таким как Призрачные полки, поскольку эти менее капризные воины адаптировались к специфики конструкции и превратили его в эффективную боевую единицу. Особенность: Стабильный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.content: 50-тонный Huntsman, разработанный Нова Котами, был создан для операции «Возрождение» и вторжения во Внутреннюю Сферу; производство началось в 3049 году. content.original: The G9B is an updated variant for the Dark Ages, fielded by the Capellan Confederation. Replacing the Gauss rifle for a Clan ER PPC was a deliberate choice to alleviate the Jinggau's ammunition dependency while maintaining damage output and eliminating the risk of internal explosions. The armor was increased to align it with other modern CCAF cavalry designs such as the Mortis and Vandal, and the medium pulse laser was upgraded to an X-Pulse model. However, the most significant changes were buried deep within: triple-strength myomer lets the 'Mech increase its mobility when it runs hot, and a supercharger provides additional speed boosts so it can quickly close with the enemy. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Introduced in the early 32nd Century, the Kodiak II 2 utilizes a number of advanced technologies which includes three torso mounted HarJel III Self-Repair Systems. content.original: In an attempt to use the popularity of the Longbow platform as a missile boat to move it into more of a closer combat profile, the -10K was created. However, this was not meet with any larger success despite using both CASE and increasing the protection to include 16 tons of armor, as there are other 'Mechs in the same weight range that were seen as performing the role better. The -10K mounted two Ultra AC/20s combined with an ER Large Laser and a Medium Pulse laser. Six tons of autocannon ammunition was carried, but only four tons of them under CASE protection - a choice that generated quite a bit of critique. Another point of contention was the XL engine used, as this was seen as making the 'Mech more prone to engine problems and reducing its reliability. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Named for the door guards who serve to ward off evil spirits from a home, the Men Shen is the first OmniMech to come from the Capellan Confederation, it borrows heavily from the Raven BattleMech for its basic design concept. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a vulnerable but light VOX 330 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is augmented by MASC system allowing the 'Mech to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The Men Shen comes with eleven tons of armor, giving it a respectable amount of protection. The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Названный в честь стражей у дверей, которые отгоняют злых духов от дома, Men Shen является первым омнимехом, пришедшим из Конфедерации Капеллы. В своём базовом концепте, мех многое заимствует у Raven. Он построен на легком шасси из эндостали и приводится в действие уязвимым, но легким двигателем VOX 330 XL, который обеспечивает ему максимальную скорость 97,2 км/ч, которая дополняется системой MASC, позволяющей меху разгоняться до 129,6 км/ч короткими рывками. Men Shen поставляется с одиннадцатью тоннами брони, что обеспечивает ему внушительный уровень защиты. Men Shen несет на своем базовом шасси активный зонд Beagle, что позволяет ему выполнять разведывательную роль независимо от его конфигурации. Для оружия и оборудования Men Shen имеет семнадцать тонн свободного пространства. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.95 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Orion has long held an important place in the Clan Wolf Touman, and the Orion C 2 is a capable heir to the favored ride of Aleksandr Kerensky. The response has been mixed, however, as it continues to use non-Clan structural components to reduce the strain on the Wolves’ industrial resources. The weapons, though, are mostly Clan. Short to medium range is covered by a Streak rack and ER medium laser, backed up with a large pulse laser in the left arm. The Orion’s standard right torso ballistic weapon was replaced by an ER large laser, both for weight and range. Having been burned by the superior range of extended LRMs, the Wolves are experimenting with the weapon system on the C 2. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

To free the needed weight the OTT-12R further uses Endo-Composite internal structure. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: This Wolf Empire variant is a much more thorough melding of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies. Built around a few central Inner Sphere-grade components - a 270-rated XL engine, seven standard jump jets, and an endo steel frame - while clad in five and a half tons of Clan-grade ferro-fibrous armor. Now better armored than the original and capable of a remarkable 151 km/h top speed, the Pack Hunter 5's sole weapon is the Clan-tech ER PPC that gave the original model its bite. Though this means the 5 is still plagued by the original's inability to engage multiple opponents, the sheer speed gained in this upgrade makes it ever easier to avoid most return fire. content.original: For the longest time it seemed the first iteration of the Pillager was consigned to history. The idea of a jumping close-assault 'Mech with twin autocannons, however, was too good not to revisit, albeit half a millennium later. Used as a bodyguard of Gauss-equipped variants, the new 6Z variant features two massive Clan LB 20-X autocannons with a deadly punch at close to medium distances. The ER large laser offers only token long-range firepower, and this pitiful, lone back-up weapon can be the downfall of inexperienced pilots. The strategios issued an order to keep the new Pillager near support 'Mechs in open terrain, but MechWarriors eager to take the fight to the enemy often choose to ignore it. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original: The recent IIC 9 is a quixotic effort. In some regards it embraces the anti-air role, with an enhanced targeting suite. Coolant pods deal with intermittent heat spikes resulting from periods of intense fire amid the relative calm experienced by anti-air units. However, the choice of reflective armor is an odd one. It offers superb protection against the common strafing attack, but in turn increases the vulnerability to equally common bomb strikes. Time will tell if pilots find the trade-off worthwhile. content.original: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1BR is powered by a 330-rated Light Fusion Engine giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. An ER PPC and a Streak SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load. MASC provides improved speed for short periods. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: Один из первых серийных квадмехов, 55-тонный Scorpion, был запущен в производство в 2570 году как юнит поддержки пехоты. Несмотря на то, что большинство мехвоинов избегали его из-за его известной нестабильности, Scorpion тем не менее использовался без перерыва на протяжении всех Наследных войн и после них. Scorpion 1BR оснащён лёгким термоядерным двигателем рейтинга 330, который обеспечивает максимальную скорость 97 км/ч. Боевая нагрузка меха включает в себя ER PPC и Streak SRM-6. Система MASC обеспечивает кратковременное увеличение скорости. Особенность: Ул. система жизнеобеспечения Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The WF1 model of the Scourge is powered by a 325-rated fusion engine, which allows this heavy 'Mech the speed to engage moderately-swift combat units. The 'Mech's four Jump Jets gives it the tactical flexibility to outmaneuver many units that it can't outpace. Protecting its vital components during battle, the 'Mech's hull is fitted with 12.5 tons of light ferro-fibrous armor. The Scourge's main weapon is an Gauss rifle, located in its left arm. This weapon is limited to sixteen rounds of ammunition. The bulk of its close-in firepower comes from four ER medium lasers in the right arm, and a single medium pulse laser located in the left arm. The array of ER medium lasers found in the 'Mech's right arm uses an advanced tech actuator enhancement system to allow the weapons better accuracy. content.original: A Dark Age overhaul built by House Davion to counter the exotic armor types in use among the DCMS, the Shadow Hawk 6D debuted in 3141. Built around a standard 275-rated Fusion Core, the Mech uses a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous armor to fit a Large Re-Engineered Laser in the Left Torso and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser in the Right Arm. An MML-5 with CASE-II protected munitions bay and a Streak SRM-2 (I-OS) round out the design. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Мех построен на стандартном термоядерном ядре рейтинга 275, использует комбинацию эндостальной и ферроволоконной брони для установки большого переделанного лазера в левом торсе и среднего переделанного лазера в правой руке. Дополняют конструкцию MML-5 с защищенным отсеком боеприпасов CASE-II и Streak SRM-2 (I-OS). Особенность: Боевые кулаки Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The new Shogun C 3 is firmly aimed at tradition-minded Clan customers. Marketed for the same niche as the old Warhawk, which still captures the minds and hearts of so many, the new Shogun increases speed at the cost of the enormous short-range damage potential of earlier variants. There are few complaints, as the C 3 may be the most balanced Shogun to date. The new Artemis V FCS and the PPC capacitor forced a replacement of the venerable original HartfordCo targeting system with a far more modern and advanced one. The new targeting solution is amongst the best available, and is one of the reasons behind the success of this new variant. Despite carrying seven tons of ammunition, the 'Mech is surprisingly tough, thanks to CASE II. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Sojourner is a simple 'Mech designed by Clan Wolf-in-Exile after the staggering loss at Arc-Royal. The 'Mech went through several design phases resulting in a final design that was both easy to maintain and pilot, with the primary use being to teach younger MechWarriors the trade of 'Mech-on-'Mech combat. As a result the pilots of these 'Mechs have a considerably higher survival rate compared to other, harder to pilot 'Mechs like the Linebacker. The base variant of the Sojourner carries a Gauss Rifle, with the compliment of a single ER Large Laser and a Plasma Cannon. The combination of 3 Jump Jets, a Supercharger and an AES system makes the 'Mech quite mobile on the battlefield despite its somewhat underpowered 240-rated Fusion Core. A CASE II system and a single external Double Heat Sink finishes up the design. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Irian developed a new variant of its classic Stalker after its latest 'Mech, the Stalker II, was snubbed by some customers due to it's limited weapon flexibility. The -9F keeps the Stalker II's hardened armor, and Irian addressed concerns regarding damage output on the modern battlefield by making its primary weapons Clan grade. Irian could supply equivalent large pulse lasers to augment the traditional Magna medium lasers. They negotiated a deal with Skate Khanate's Beta Aimag for missile launchers and sensors in return for a percentage of the production output. The STK-9F's combination of durability and destructive potential made it a common sight in this region of the Inner Sphere. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Swordsman was an early Federated Suns medium-class BattleMech which was originally built in 2463 as House Davion's third in-house BattleMech design. The design was tainted by heavy use in the Davion Civil War of 2525-2540. Eventually, production ended and the design was relegated to the dustbin of history. However, in the 3060s, the mech was put back into production by House Davion to supplement their forces in the FedCom Civil War. The SWD-2 is the stock production design, mounting heavy armor and firepower for the tonnage: 7.5 tons of armor and a grab-bag mix of guns including an AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, two Medium Lasers, and a Small Laser. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The 'Mech features a 300-rated XL engine with MASC and a Supercharger, allowing it to reach high speeds normally found on lighter machines. Enhancing its mobility further are five jump jets, giving it a jump capacity of 150 meters. The Thresher Mk II's armament features a mix of long range and short range options. Its main battery of guns consists of an ER PPC with a LRM-15, supplied with two tons of ammunition. At shorter ranges, a large pulse laser coupled with a SRM-4 and flamer are available for use. Its ammunition is protected by CASE II, greatly decreasing damage to the right torso from ammo explosions and allowing the XL engine to continue operating with little fear of damage. Clan Sea Fox chose to protect the 'Mech with 9.5 tons of Gamma Special Reflective armor. This armor gives the 'Mech resistance to energy weapons, but makes it more vulnerable to artillery and some ballistic weapons. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: Recently deployed in considerable numbers in the CCAF, the Vindicator -7L returns the 'Mech to its rugged, generalist nature. While most of the package remains unchanged, Ferro-Fibrous armor increases protection for less weight, while a reinforced chassis and CASE II greatly improve durability. The biggest surprise is the addition of a Clan Kingston ER PPC, supplied by Skate Khanate. The Capellans adapted it to work with the Vindicator's simple but effective cooling jacket. Now longer-ranged, harder-hitting, and possessing greater endurance, the -7L has proven to be a deadly combatant in the Capellan March and along the Free Worlds border. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This version uses an XXL Engine to reach top speeds of 86 km/h. Its weapon load hearkens back to the original Warhammer, carrying ER PPCs in the arms and a single ER Medium Laser and ER Small Laser in the left and right torso. An SRM-6 is also carried in the right torso, and an ECM Suite disrupts enemy communications and targeting. This version is protected by Heat-Dissipating Armor. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Оригинальный Warhammer был разработан как штурмовой боевой мех. Однако он был вытеснен более поздними и более тяжёлыми мехами, хотя и оставался мощной оружейной платформой. Кланы благоразумно сохранили и построили на этой прочной раме настоящий штурмовой мех — Warhammer IIC. Эта версия оснащена двигателем XXL, позволяющим развивать максимальную скорость 86 км/ч. Вооружение соответствует оригинальному Warhammer: в руках установлены ER PPC, а в левом и правом торсе — один ER Medium Laser и один ER Small Laser. В правом торсе также установлена SRM-6, а система РЭБ нарушает связь и наведение противника. Эта версия защищена теплорассеивающей броней. Особенность: Встроенный прожектор Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.2 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

Designed by the Raven Alliance, this variant replaces the standard Fusion Core of the IIC-1 with an XL Engine. An LRM-15 is mounted in each side torso with 3 tons of ammo allocated to the launchers. The IIC-13 is otherwise identical to the IIC-1 with the exception of reduced armor. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Оригинальный Warhammer был разработан как штурмовой боевой мех. Однако он был вытеснен более поздними и более тяжёлыми мехами, хотя и оставался мощной оружейной платформой. Кланы благоразумно сохранили и построили на этой прочной раме настоящий штурмовой мех — Warhammer IIC. Разработанный Альянсом Ворона, этот вариант заменяет стандартный термоядерный двигатель IIC-1 на XL двигатель. В каждом полуторсе установлены LRM-15 с боезапасом в 3 тонны. В остальном IIC-13 идентичен IIC-1, за исключением уменьшенной брони. Особенность: Встроенный прожектор Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.2 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 280-rated Light Engine and armored in Ballistic Reinforced armor, the Warhammer WHM-10K is armed with a pair of ER PPCs. Paired Medium Lasers, ER Small Lasers, Clan Machine Guns and a Streak SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. Clan DHS and CASE II round out the design. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

An XXL engine maintains the top ground speed of 86 km/h, and eight Improved Jump Jets allow the 'Mech to cover 240 meters per jump. Like the White Raven it carries a Targeting Computer for its weapons. The armament includes two ER Small Lasers in each arm, a Large Pulse Laser in each side torso, and two Medium Pulse Lasers in the center torso. Ten double heat sinks are equipped. This variant, unlike the first White Raven, is protected by standard armor instead of Ferro-Lamellor. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: Following the HPG blackout and the splintering of the Republic, TharHes Industries hastily reopened the Wolfhound line that had been destroyed during the Jihad. Based upon the WLF-5, albeit with TharHes’s original stylings, the -6S variant drops the MASC system and the entire weapons array. A large re-engineered laser is mounted in the right arm, with enhanced actuators to provide increased accuracy. As with the -3S, three ER medium lasers provide backup. A small X-pulse laser covers the rear. The Wolfhound is once again a match for the Combine’s Panther Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

The haphazard WVR-7D was followed by several Project Phoenix models before the Talon factory disappeared in nuclear fire during the Jihad. Not content to lose a defining medium ’Mech after the success of the SHD-6D, the AFFS financed rapid production of the WVR-10D at Kallon of Wernke. Its performance compares well with the initial run of Conjurers built at Thermopolis for the Wolf Empire. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The XNS-01-A is a unlicensed attempt at copying the XNT-7O, produced by at an unknown Deep Periphery location by an unknown party. Being sold for considerably less than the official version, it is not unusual to see it with different pirate bands. Due to being an illegal copy of the real design, the Clan tech weapons have been replaced by older IS counterparts and the engine core has been shrunken considerably. The cooling has also worsened, as the double heat sinks were changed to single heat sinks to cut costs further. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original: The Pollux ADA Heavy Tank was a dedicated air defense artillery vehicle designed to serve as a component of the Terran Hegemony's planetary defense forces. Armed with a Sniper Artillery Piece and a LB 10-X Autocannon, the Pollux carried 3 tons of ammunition for each weapon.A turret mounted Medium Laser and forward facing Small Pulse Laser gave the tank some token means of close-in self-defense. Also protecting the tank is 6 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor giving its hull modest strength ward off light attacks as its escorts take out would be attackers. content.original: The Jumping Jack, developed by Clan Hell's Horses and inspired by the Arion Quadvee, is a highly versatile hybrid combat unit resembling the huntsman spider. Armed with an array of AP Gauss rifles, this BattleMech packs a powerful punch for short-range engagements. With a top speed of 97 km/h, jump jets for enhanced mobility, and its unique quadrupedal design, the Jumping Jack can swiftly traverse the battlefield and deliver devastating strikes. Its maxed armor provides increased durability, making it an ideal hunter of infantry and battle armor units. The Jumping Jack's blend of firepower, durability, and anti-infantry capabilities makes it a formidable asset, capable of clearing the way for Clan Hell's Horses forces in combat situations without sacrificing speed and agility. Quirk: QuadVee Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: The Boreas R variant, also known as the Amirault, is a tribute to the renowned Hells Horses MechWarrior, Joshua Amirault. This variant features an Endo Steel frame that enhances its durability without sacrificing mobility. Its original weapon systems have been replaced with four LRM 15 missile launchers and three ER Medium Lasers, providing devastating long-range firepower coupled with moderate close-range capability. The Boreas R also boasts an advanced cooling system that utilizes prototype heat sinks, which allow the MechWarrior to fire its weapons without worrying about heat management issues. Quirk: QuadVee Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The brainchild of Stefan Amaris, the Dragoon BattleMech was envisioned as part of Amaris's ambitious plan to create a family of 'modular' multi-mission combat units for his Amaris Empire Armed Forces. In the year following the Amaris Coup, now-Emperor Amaris would have a means to make his dream into reality, and he began swiftly issuing contracts which would lead to the creation of the Dragoon. Originally built by Krupp Stellar Technologies Inc., the Dragoon was designed with a similar modular subsystem akin to the Mercury. With this system, the 'Mech's maintenance loads would be eased. Its modular nature would allow repair depots and factories to be able to reconfigure the design's weapons systems and its power plant for any needed mission-specific specs.

content.original: The Hammerhead is a medium-sized Clan BattleMech designed as a skirmisher by Clan Sea Fox. Designed to loosely resemble a hammerhead shark, the design is intended to be aggressive with its opponents, yet also built around the concept of never getting knocked off its feet. Despite its merely adequate weapons array, the Hammerhead has achieved great success as a shock trooper wading though enemy formations to brawl with opponents twice its size at close range.

content.original: The Pollux ADA Heavy Tank was a dedicated air defense artillery vehicle designed to serve as a component of the Terran Hegemony's planetary defense forces. Armed with a Sniper Artillery Piece and a LB 10-X Autocannon, the Pollux carried 3 tons of ammunition for each weapon.A turret mounted Medium Laser and forward facing Small Pulse Laser gave the tank some token means of close-in self-defense. Also protecting the tank is 6 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor giving its hull modest strength ward off light attacks as its escorts take out would be attackers. Powering the vehicle is a GM 225-rated standard Fusion Engine, giving the vehicle modest speeds to keep with typical vehicle formation and heavy 'Mechs Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: The Jumping Jack, developed by Clan Hell's Horses and inspired by the Arion Quadvee, is a highly versatile hybrid combat unit resembling the huntsman spider. Armed with an array of AP Gauss rifles, this BattleMech packs a powerful punch for short-range engagements. With a top speed of 97 km/h, jump jets for enhanced mobility, and its unique quadrupedal design, the Jumping Jack can swiftly traverse the battlefield and deliver devastating strikes. Its maxed armor provides increased durability, making it an ideal hunter of infantry and battle armor units. The Jumping Jack's blend of firepower, durability, and anti-infantry capabilities makes it a formidable asset, capable of clearing the way for Clan Hell's Horses forces in combat situations without sacrificing speed and agility. Quirk: QuadVee Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: The Boreas R variant, also known as the Amirault, is a tribute to the renowned Hells Horses MechWarrior, Joshua Amirault. This variant features an Endo Steel frame that enhances its durability without sacrificing mobility. Its original weapon systems have been replaced with four LRM 15 missile launchers and three ER Medium Lasers, providing devastating long-range firepower coupled with moderate close-range capability. The Boreas R also boasts an advanced cooling system that utilizes prototype heat sinks, which allow the MechWarrior to fire its weapons without worrying about heat management issues. Quirk: QuadVee Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Sheathed in hardened armor, the Cyclops C is a bit slower but much tougher than its forebears. A token but efficient weapons array exists merely to protect the 'Mech's sophisticated communications equipment. A powerful force multiplier, the Cyclops C has been issued to Dominion PGCs, with a focus on Phalanxes to improve unit coordination. The simple, rugged 'Mech is an attractive alternative to the Clan's more advanced offerings. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22

content.content: «Циклоп» CP-C, покрытый прочной броней, немного медленнее, но гораздо выносливее своих предшественников. Скудный, но эффективный комплекс вооружений нужен для защиты сложного коммуникационного оборудования на мехе. Cyclops C - это хороший усилитель отряда, он был поставлен на вооружение Dominion PGC, вместе с Phalanxes, для улучшения координации юнитов. Простой и надежный, этот мех является привлекательной альтернативой более современным разработкам Кланов. Особенность: Battle Computer B2000 Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.22

content.content: После вторжения войск клана Адских Лошадей в Доминион Расальхаг во время операции Noyan в 3147 году был разработан «Мастодонт», ознаменовавший собой существенный сдвиг в сторону от прежней зависимости от различных модификаций Executioner как основы армии. Эффективность «Мастодонта» после его введения в эксплуатацию неизбежно делает его одним из лидеров многих будущих кампаний. Мощно укреплённая конструкция выдерживает как орудийный огонь, так и стандартный износ, неизбежный в большинстве кампаний. Конфигурация A сочетает в себе пусковую установку LRM-15 с Artemis IV, три больших импульсных лазера и пушку Гаусса. Особенность: Прочный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.18 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.
