Like the traditional Phoenix Hawk, this version carries a Clan medium pulse laser and AP Gauss rifle in each arm. The right arm also carries a Clan large pulse laser. All these weapons are tied into a Clan-built targeting computer. What makes this version stand out is the supercharger which allows the 'Mech to reach 120 km/h Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: A proposed Dark Age overhaul of the classic Phoenix Hawk, the PHX-99 is a unique take on the standard Phoenix Hawk. Emphasizing armor over mobility, the PHX-99 is coated in Hardened Armor, reinforced by a Heavy Duty Gyro and Modular Armor. To fit this in, the engine has been downgraded to a 50-rated Fusion Core, forcing the Mech to rely on a pair of Improved Jump Jets for mobility. Armed with a Large X-Pulse Laser, a pair of ER Medium Lasers and a pair of ER Small Lasers, the PHX-99 is considered a failed prototype for a reason. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: Debuting in 3142 on the King of the Mountain, Jasmine is a customized PXH-7K variant piloted by Team Genie's Lindsey Larkin in the 3146 Royal Fantasy Tournament. Mounting standard jump jets to save weight, Jasmine adds a PPC capacitor to the snub-nose PPC in its right arm, supported by a right torso-mounted RL-10 and twin ER medium laser in the left arm. While boasting an extra-half ton of armor, the majority of the extra weight reclaimed from removing the 7K's improved jump jets allows Jasmine to amount an Angel ECM suite and a Drone Command Console that its pilot uses to command a companion Celerity drone dubbed Rajah in the arenas. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

content.content: Впервые представленный Терранской гегемонией в 2568 году, Phoenix Hawk был одним из самых известных боевых мехов во Внутренней Сфере. Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: Constructed using Inner Sphere technologies, the 'Mech design was envisioned with economics in mind. The Avalanche is powered by a 250-rated fusion engine, giving it a modest maximum speed of 86 km/h, while its hull is protected by 10 tons of standard armor, which gives it less armor protection than other designs of the time. Mobility is enhanced with five jump jets, and CASE mounted in its right torso protected against complete destruction from a magazine detonation. Additional equipment and weapons are allotted 16 tons of pod space, giving decent flexibility. The Avalanche gains its name from its primary configuration which consists of two LRM-10 launchers in its torso, which obscure it in a white, snow-like cloud of smoke when firing. These are backed up with a quartet of ER medium lasers mounted in the arms. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Avalanche is a thirty-second century medium OmniMech, first deployed by the Draconis Combine and Clan Nova Cat. After decades of development, the Avalanche would still have a number of design flaws which would give it a bad reputation among warriors of Clan Nova Cat. The 'Mech would soon be deployed shortly before House Kurita's invasion of the Republic of the Sphere, where it would serve among House Kurita's elite forces. After the destruction of Clan Nova Cat, as a result of its revolt against Coordinator Yori Kurita, the dead Clan's allotment of Avalanches would be sold off to other Inner Sphere powers.

content.original: The Awesome is traditionally used in a vanguard role when penetrating enemy defenses. The Awesome's massive firepower also lends it to defensive actions, acting as a mobile turret when necessary. Because of its reliance on PPCs, the Awesome is able to act independently for extended periods of time. This trait is also useful in siege situations where the 'Mech can keep up a constant barrage, allowing it to win battles of attrition through bleeding an enemy dry. The only downsides to the Awesome is its low maneuverability and lack of rear-facing weaponry, making it vulnerable to being outflanked and surrounded by lighter 'Mechs, although good intelligence and a well-deployed screening force can mitigate this issue.

content.content: «Потрясающий» традиционно используется в роли авангарда при прорыве вражеской обороны. Массивная огневая мощь Awesome также позволяет использовать его в оборонительных действиях, при необходимости выступая в роли мобильной турели. Благодаря использованию PPC, Awesome способен действовать автономно в течение длительного времени. Эта особенность также полезна в осадных ситуациях, когда мехи могут вести постоянный обстрел, позволяя выигрывать битвы на истощение за счет обескровливания противника. Единственным недостатком Awesome является низкая маневренность и отсутствие заднего оружия, что делает его уязвимым для захода и обстрела в спину более легкими мехами, хотя хорошая разведка и хорошо развернутые силы прикрытия могут смягчить эту проблему.

content.original: The Brahma was designed after the Taurian Concordat was invaded during the Jihad. During that time, the Taurian Defense Force took heavy losses when they put their older machines up against the cutting edge technologies available to the Federated Suns. Though the Taurians were successful in driving the AFFS out of Taurian space and inflicted notable losses on the Federated Suns, the cost to the Concordat in men and matériel was just too high. With that realization uppermost in their minds, the TDF commissioned a new BattleMech that would force the Taurian industrial community to upgrade their factories. If the factory wasn't able to build a component the designers wanted, the TDF reallocated funds to add that production capability to the factory. Thus the Brahma serves not only as a BattleMech for combat, but as a technology driver as well. Though the designers originally wanted a 55 ton 'Mech that would complement the Griffin, Shadow Hawk, and Wolverine, they were unable to fit all the technology in a medium 'Mech chassis. The Brahma therefore displaces sixty tons.

content.original: The original Fire Moth, designated Dasher by the Inner Sphere, is a light 'Mech that is known for having great speed but weak armor, and it was found that the Dasher was not very effective at swarm tactics or raiding due to this deficiency. Because of this deficiency in the design the Dasher II entered service during the Word of Blake Jihad. Much heavier and sturdier than the original Dasher, the Dasher II has a top speed of 162 km/h that equals that of the original Dasher. The Dasher II's top speed allows it to close in to effectively use its firepower.

content.original: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The prime variant was designed for anti-air role and fire support.

content.original: The Exhumer is a medium BattleMech first produced for the Draconis Combine in the third decade of the thirty-second century. The 'Mech was first advocated to enter the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery by Benjamin District Warlord Mitsura Sakamoto, who felt that the design would become a mainstay of the Combine's Armed forces. With the Warlord's backing, the 'Mech would finally enter service with its first production models joining the 2nd Benjamin Regulars in 3129. However, early engagements using the 'Mech by frontline forces would prove disastrous due to a flaw in the Exhumer's targeting systems. The 'Mech orders from DCMS were subsequently canceled, shuffling the produced units to sale in the mercenary market.

content.original: Designed for long-range combat, the Gambit was a solid, light BattleMech, the second 'Mech to have been brought to market by Adam Tech Industries. Straightforward to maintain and built around some of the most popular items on the market including armor plating, heat sinks, and myomer bundles, the Gambit was very popular with 'Mech technicians following its entry to service in 3136. Adding to the Gambit's appeal for MechWarriors was the cockpit, which in addition to featuring a reliable emergency release mechanism, was also armored to resist battle armor-scale weapons for at least 10 seconds - a feature clearly intended to make the Gambit suitable for use in the battlefields of the Dark Ages.

content.original: The Götterdämmerung is a Heavy class BattleMech first fielded by the Lyran Commonwealth in 3138, the 'Mech's German name translates to twilight of the gods or ragnarök. The Götterdämmerung's durability is due in part of layers of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor, while Blackstone would move the cockpit of the 'Mech to the torso. The Torso-Mounted Cockpit's ejection system is highly complex, making escape from the Götterdämmerung difficult under certain circumstances. MechWarriors piloting the 'Mech need also be wary of losing their side torsos, due to the split placement of their life support systems.

content.original: A melding of the popular Star League era Thug and the poorly regarded Charger, the samurai-themed Hatamoto-Chi was the first post–Succession Wars Draconis Combine BattleMech constructed utilizing recovered LosTech. Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. While initially unable to mass produce the advanced Endo Steel chassis required to match the Thug, the appearance of the early Hatamoto-Chi and their endless variations born of the Charger's spacious torso sent the combined Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth into confusion during the War of 3039.

content.content: Являясь смесью популярного Thug эпохи Звездной Лиги и не пользующегося популярностью Charger, Hatamoto-Chi в стиле самураев был первым боевым мехом Синдиката Дракона, построенным после Наследных войн с использованием восстановленного лостеха. По поручению канреи Теодора Куриты провести обратную разработку образцов передовых боевых мехов СОЗЛ, предоставленных КомСтаром в 3035 году для будущего производства, Luthien Armor Works тайно соединила вооружение Thug с обликом злосчастного Charger. Хотя изначально компания не могла массово производить передовые шасси из эндостали, необходимые для Thug, появление ранних Hatamoto-Chi и их бесконечных вариаций, созданных на основе просторного корпуса Charger, привело к замешательству в объединенных вооруженных силах Федеративного Содружества во время войны 3039 года.

content.original: Another post-Blackout variant, this 'Mech is a regimental or battalion commander's unit. It uses the same chassis, engine, and armor layout as the Hatamoto-suna. Its only armament is a pair of Clan-spec ER medium lasers and a single Extended LRM-15 with three tons of ammunition. To compensate, the Hatamoto-godai is equipped with a Guardian ECM Suite, Bloodhound Active Probe, two C3 boosted master computers, and a Command Console that has been armored. To defend against incoming missile fire, it has a Clan-built Laser Anti-Missile System in the right torso. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Hercules was built in response to a request by the Free Worlds League for a 'Mech with balanced mobility and firepower. The Hercules is powered by a 350 XL engine that propels the 'Mech up to speeds of 86.4 km/h. The Hercules is also well armored, with eleven tons of Heavy ferro-fibrous for protection. Overall, the Hercules has turned out to be a good all-around trooper 'Mech that can handle a variety of combat roles, from air defense to long-range direct fire support.

content.original: The Jackalope JLP-BD's eight jump jets and 240-rated XL engine allow it to leap up to 240 meters and reach a top speed of 129 km/h, giving it the ability deploy rapidly and quickly get to wherever it needs to go on the battlefield. This speed gives it an additional degree of protection beyond its six and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor and its Clean Sweep laser anti-missile system. Its key component is its Clan designed light active probe, making it a valuable scout while leaving enough room for additional equipment. The 'Mech's principal weaponry includes two Clan-tech ER medium lasers, which are located in its stubby but flexible arms. Additionally, an ATM-6 launcher mounted in the right torso provides the Jackalope added punch at all ranges. However the design only has room for one ton of ammunition, cutting down its endurance in longer campaigns and reducing the pilot to reliance on the lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Produced jointly by Victory Conditions Industries and Eris Enterprises, the Jackalope represented a leap forward in anti-missile and recon technology. Designed to serve in recon and pursuit lances, this compact and swift BattleMech was used to full effect in combat, and additionally served as a training 'Mech and as an arena combat 'Mech. The 'Mech gets its name from a mythical animal which was said to have existed on Terra's North American continent.

content.content: Разработанный совместно компаниями Victory Conditions Industries и Eris Enterprises, «Джакалоп» представлял собой прорыв в технологиях противоракетной обороны и разведки. Этот компактный и быстрый боевой мех, предназначенный для использования в разведывательных и преследовательских копьях, эффективно применялся в бою, а также служил учебным мехом и мехом для боев на арене. Название происходит от мифического животного, которое, как говорят, обитало на североамериканском континенте Терры.

Designed to serve in recon and pursuit lances, this compact and swift BattleMech was used to full effect in combat, and additionally served as a training 'Mech and as an arena combat 'Mech. The 'Mech gets its name from a mythical animal which was said to have existed on Terra's North American continent.

content.original: Intended as a symbol of Inner Sphere/Clan unity, the Kuma (Japanese for "Bear") is a fast if lightly armed Ghost Bear Dominion heavy cavalry BattleMech. While derisively referred to by some as the Charger IIC, the specialist Kuma was a heavy cornerstone to light Stars in the post-Jihad Dominion touman. Built on an Endo Steel frame, powered by an enormous 360 XL fusion engine and equipped with a large number of Improved Jump Jets, the Kuma is one of the most mobile heavy 'Mechs ever built, with a ground speed equal to the medium-weight Phoenix Hawk and a jump distance as high as the light-weight Spider. Clad in ten and half tons of standard armor, eleven Double Heat Sinks are barely able to cope with the design's weaponry and jump jets.

content.original: Constructed using Inner Sphere technologies, the 'Mech design was envisioned with economics in mind. The Avalanche is powered by a 250-rated fusion engine, giving it a modest maximum speed of 86 km/h, while its hull is protected by 10 tons of standard armor, which gives it less armor protection than other designs of the time. Mobility is enhanced with five jump jets, and CASE mounted in its right torso protected against complete destruction from a magazine detonation. Additional equipment and weapons are allotted 16 tons of pod space, giving decent flexibility. The Avalanche gains its name from its primary configuration which consists of two LRM-10 launchers in its torso, which obscure it in a white, snow-like cloud of smoke when firing. These are backed up with a quartet of ER medium lasers mounted in the arms. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The newest variant, a joint project between IBMU and Alshain Weaponry, was introduced in 3067. The 'Mech utilizes Irian's Compact Engine and Compact Gyro to save space at the expense of mass. It retains the speed and ECM of the 9Q, but utilizes an Endo Steel structure. Two Heavy PPCs deal a good amount of damage in each blow, while a Snub-Nose PPC is deadly and accurate at close range. At the time of its introduction the 10KM was reserved for only the elite units of the Free Worlds League and Draconis Combine, and thanks to an iron-clad contract even the wily Irian Technologies had trouble finding a loophole to sell the 'Mech to the other Houses or mercenary units. The weight freed up by the engine swap allows this variant to carry more than twice the armor of its progenitor design. Особенность: Узкий/низкий профиль Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.08

content.original: This variant is equipped for close combat. It carries a chain whip and Triple Strength Myomer, while an XL gyro and XXL engine free up space for more weaponry. The Dasher II 4 carries two LRM-5 launchers, an ER large laser, ER medium laser, and ER small laser, while a single micro pulse laser provides some anti-infantry support. The 'Mech's top speed is usually 100 km/h, but with the TSM active it can hit 110 km/h. Eight improved jump jets allow it to cover 240 meters per jump, and the Dasher II 4's armor protection is enhanced with the use of hardened armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

content.original: Created for the mercenary market, the 3P is geared towards short-range combat. The ER large lasers are swapped out for large pulse lasers, while its remaining missiles systems swapped out for three SRM-2 launchers, one found in each of the 'Mech's torsos. A single ER small laser mounted in the center torso rounds out the armaments. To allow the design to close quickly with its target, Triple Strength Myomer is added to the design, with weight being freed by the removal of two of the double heat sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Jackalope JLP-BD's eight jump jets and 240-rated XL engine allow it to leap up to 240 meters and reach a top speed of 129 km/h, giving it the ability deploy rapidly and quickly get to wherever it needs to go on the battlefield. This speed gives it an additional degree of protection beyond its six and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor and its Clean Sweep laser anti-missile system. Its key component is its Clan designed light active probe, making it a valuable scout while leaving enough room for additional equipment. The 'Mech's principal weaponry includes two Clan-tech ER medium lasers, which are located in its stubby but flexible arms. Additionally, an ATM-6 launcher mounted in the right torso provides the Jackalope added punch at all ranges. However the design only has room for one ton of ammunition, cutting down its endurance in longer campaigns and reducing the pilot to reliance on the lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Developed by Majesty M&M from battle data gathered in engagements with the Word of Blake's patterns of Phoenix Hawk BattleMechs, the Agrotera is a fast, hard-hitting Medium 'Mech packed with some of the most cutting-edge technology available. An XL 300 fusion engine and 240-meter jump capacity give the Agrotera excellent agility for it's weight class, while 9.5 tons of armor keep it reasonably safe against the hits that do land. The Agrotera is no slouch giving hits back, sporting an ERPPC linked to an advanced Actuator Enhancement System, backed by a Medium VSPL. A single normal Medium Pulse Laser and a pair of Small Pulse Lasers round out the Agrotera's arsenal and leave it well equipped to handle virtually any battlefield threat, entirely independent from supply line restrictions.

content.original: Built by Luthien Armor Works of New Samarkand, the Hitotsume Kozo is a medium BattleMech designed to serve in the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery. This 'Mech's creation was partially influenced by an unofficial cultural rebirth. Keeping this in mind, LAW styled the appearance of the Hitotsume Kozo after the ancient Japanese Bushido armor worn by the samurai warriors during that time period on Terra. It received a poor reception by front-line troops due its advanced features and high heat output; however, it was appreciated when transferred to less-favored combat units, such as Ghost Regiments, as these less-fickle warriors adapted to the design's quirks and turned it into an effective combat unit.

content.content: «Хитосуне Козо», построенный компанией Luthien Armor Works на Новом Самарканде, представляет собой средний боевой мех, предназначенный для службы в составе мобилизованных солдат Синдиката Дракона. На создание этого меха отчасти повлияло неофициальное культурное возрождение. Учитывая это, LAW стилизовали внешний вид Hitotsume Kozo по образцу древних японских доспехов бусидо, которые носили самураи в тот период на Терре. Он был плохо принят войсками на передовой из-за высокой теплоотдачи и ряда особенностей; однако он был оценен по достоинству при передаче менее популярным боевым подразделениям, таким как Призрачные полки, поскольку эти менее капризные воины адаптировались к специфики конструкции и превратили его в эффективную боевую единицу.

content.original: The Legionnaire was developed as the Federated Suns answer to the Lyran Blitzkrieg, and entered production during the Word of Blake Jihad. A lance of Legionnaires played an important role in the Third Battle of New Avalon, where they quickly assaulted the Blakist force's left flank as they were attempting to ford the Thames river, breaking their momentum and eventually forcing them off world. Capable of reaching 118 km/h, the Legionnaire is a fast flanker.

Копьё легионеров сыграло важную роль в Третьей битве за Новый Авалон, где они стремительно атаковали левый фланг блейкистов, пытавшихся переправиться через Темзу, сломив их натиск и в конечном итоге вытеснив с планеты. Using a number of components shared with the Hatchetman 7D and Caesar 5D, the AXM-5N carries a Tiburon Khanate–supplied HAG 20 in its right torso, supported by a left arm–mounted Sea Fox Clan ER PPC and a trio of IS-grade ER medium lasers in the right arm, and fitted with a Guardian ECM suite. Though carrying three tons of HAG reloads, the AXM-5N primarily relies on its energy weaponry to activate its triple strength myomer to enhance both its speed and the damage inflicted with its hatchet. content.original: A further development of the New Samarkand Metals model of 3062 this mixed tech Behemoth is protected by the Combine's own Ballistic Reinforced Armor. The twin Ultra AC/10 are retained, now enhanced with a targeting computer. A trio of Clan grade Streak SRM6 replace the assortment of missiles, and a pair of front mounted ER Medium lasers complete it's armament. Introduced in 2952, the Behemoth was designed for increased firepower and heavy armor rather than speed or manoeuvrability. The design allowed the Behemoth to engage both distant and short-range targets, while allowing it to stand up to almost any type of unit possible. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: Due to a lack of XL engines for the Behemoth II, Aldis was compelled to merge modified Behemoth II turrets onto regular Behemoth chassis. The Behemoth II's thunderbolt launchers and most of its weapons are swapped out for eight MML 5 launchers and plenty of ammunition. If a target tries to close in, the capacity to launch at least fifteen SRMs—often infernos—in any direction is a lethal deterrent. Introduced in 2952, the Behemoth was designed for increased firepower and heavy armor rather than speed or manoeuvrability. content.original: The SM Tank Destroyer was designed as a speedy infighter by scientists from Clan Nova Cat. The machine is a cheap and effective combat vehicle. The vehicle has unique 'glass' dual cockpits on the front of the vehicle that are functionally identical while mounting a smaller anti-infantry turret just behind its left side cockpit. The vehicle's unique split cockpit design allows the cockpit modules to eject from the vehicle. Due to its appearance, the SM1 was dubbed the 'Suicide Machine' by its first pilots because they felt overexposed with the tank's all ferro-glass cockpit. Biome Restrictions: None. Машина оснащена уникальными «стеклянными» двойными кабинами в передней части, функционально идентичными, а также малой противопехотной турелью, расположенной сразу слева от кабины. Уникальная конструкция разделённой кабины позволяет катапультировать модули кабины. Из-за внешнего вида первые пилоты SM1 прозвали её «Суицид-машиной», поскольку чувствовали себя слишком уязвимыми в полностью ферростеклянной кабине танка. Ограничения биома: нет. content.original: The Arion, developed by Clan Hell's Horses, is a versatile hybrid combat unit designed for both BattleMech and tank configurations. Equipped with an ER Large Laser and two SRM-4 launchers, the Arion is capable of delivering devastating firepower at medium to long ranges. With a top speed of 97 km/h, it can rapidly traverse the battlefield and reposition as needed. The Arion's conversion capability allows it to operate as either a fast, heavily armed BattleMech or a heavily armored tank with a low profile, depending on the mission's needs. In BattleMech mode, the Arion is capable of agile and dynamic movements, thanks to its quadrupedal design. When converted to a tank, the Arion provides an armored, low-profile platform with a powerful punch. Despite its versatility, the Arion is not as heavily armored as traditional BattleMechs, and its conversion process takes time and resources, making it less effective in rapidly changing combat situations. Nevertheless, its ability to perform in multiple roles makes it a valuable asset in a wide range of missions. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

Он также оснащён усовершенствованным эндокомпозитным каркасом, защищённым тринадцатью с половиной тоннами брони. Семнадцать двойных клановых охладителей позволяют контролировать тепловую нагрузку. Правая рука несёт средний щит и оснащена передовым компьютером наведения. Вооружение полностью клановое. Чёрный рыцарь оснащён ER РРС, двумя большими ER-лазерами, двумя средними ER-лазерами, двумя малыми ER-лазерами и двумя малыми импульсными лазерами. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11

content.original: A typical IIC Version, the BL-IIC-KNT is rebuilt to be updated with Clan technology. Combining several types of weapons, its total weaponary is quite impressive considering its size. The largest weapon is its LBX AC/10, which is the only ballistic weapon except for two AMS for self-protection. The 'Mech carries three different type of missile launchers, one LRM-15, one SRM-6 and two Stream SRM-2. The remaining weapons are all energy based, one ER PPC and five lasers of various types. The heavy armament is only possible by using a 300 XL engine, Endo Steel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor. An Active Probe is mounted in the Center Torso. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.original: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.

content.content: «Чёрный рыцарь» был разработан как боевая машина первой линии, так и как командный боевой мех на уровне роты и батальона для Сил обороны Звездной Лиги. Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

content.original: Produced on Shitara for The Republic of the Sphere, the Thunderbird II battle armor is an upgrade of the Thunderbird battle armor produced by Clan Nova Cat expats. The modular weapons mount of the original were replaced with a Detachable Weapon Pack in each arm. The left arm carries a single AP Gauss Rifle while the right arm carries a LB-X (Battle Armor). Reflective armor protects the Thunderbird II. What makes it so deadly in the Republic Armed Forces is the integrated Battle Armor C3 system. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.955 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

Модульное оружейное крепление оригинальной брони было заменено съёмным оружейным комплектом в каждой руке. В левой руке установлена ​​одна противопехотная винтовка Гаусса, а в правой — LB-X (боевой брони). «Тандербёрд II» защищён отражающей броней. Интегрированная система C3 для боевой брони делает его смертоносным в Вооружённых силах Республики. Особенность: Устрашающий Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.955 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Black Wolf is a thirty-second century, Heavy Class battle armor which was originally created by Clan Scientists from both halves of the divided Wolf Clan. The battle armor began as a joint project between Clan Wolf and Clan Wolf-in-Exile, as part of a means of reunification between the two sundered factions. However, the reunification the Black Wolf suggested would not come to pass with the later formation of the Wolf Empire in 3142. One of the Black Wolf's deployments would be during the invasion of Tharkad in 3143, where the suit's use would become a symbol of terror for Clan Wolf-in-Exile's allies in the Lyran Commonwealth.

content.original: Paying tribute to other highly successful Clan Wolf designs, the Blood Reaper is a symbolic and straightforward second-line BattleMech in heavy use in the post-Jihad Clan Wolf touman. Seeking to standardize his forces and weed out non-Wolf designs, Khan Vlad Ward ordered his scientists to develop a rugged yet symbolic 'Mech for warriors of Clan Wolf to rally around. A standard BattleMech in the mold of the successful Tundra Wolf, the Blood Reaper first entered service in 3079 and went on to form a large part of the Wolves' post-Jihad touman. Khan Ward overcame the stigma of a second-line machine with classic Clan posturing; by insisting that warriors truly worthy of the spirit of the Wolf would win even while being hobbled by such a design.

content.original: The Boreas Prime's D configuration is optimized for devastating energy output. With a pair of Heavy Large Lasers mounted on either side of its torso, this configuration can deliver overwhelming firepower at medium to long range. However, this increase in firepower comes at a cost, as the heat buildup from firing both lasers simultaneously can quickly overtax the mech's heat management systems. To mitigate this, four additional Laser Heat Sinks are added to the configuration, allowing the Boreas to maintain its firepower for longer periods of time before needing to cool down. This configuration is ideal for situations where overwhelming firepower is necessary, but care must be taken to avoid overheating the mech. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

With a top speed of 64 km/h, it is capable of quickly maneuvering around the battlefield. Its OmniMech design allows for modular customization, making it a versatile platform for any mission. It is a potent combatant in the hands of a skilled pilot. Its QuadVee hybrid design provides additional stability and mobility, making it suitable for rough terrain. Its combination of firepower, maneuverability, and versatility make it a formidable opponent on the battlefield.

content.original: Initially under development by Clan Ghost Bear as directed by Galaxy Commander Ramiel \"Warbear\" Bekker and named for the Grecian nymph in the Terran constellation of Ursa Major, the Callisto was designed to correct a tactical deficiency in the Rasalhague Dominion's infantry. The development resulted in two near identical versions of the Battle Armor, with only serial numbers and machining details being the only major differentiation between the two. The Callisto is based on the time tested Elemental Battle Suit making it a both recognizable, if a bit peculiar sight, and easy for warriors to switch to should the need arise. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Первоначально разрабатывавшийся кланом Призрачного Медведя под руководством командира галактики Рамиэля «Боевого Медведя» Беккера и названный в честь греческой нимфы из созвездия Большой Медведицы на Терре, «Каллисто» был разработан для устранения тактического недостатка пехоты Доминиона Расальхаг. В результате появились две практически идентичные версии боевой брони, единственными существенными различиями между которыми были лишь серийные номера и пара деталей. «Каллисто» создан на основе проверенного временем боевого костюма «Элементал», что делает его узнаваемым, хотя и несколько необычным, и позволяет воинам легко переключиться на него при необходимости. Особенность: Intuitive Controls Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Initially under development by Clan Ghost Bear as directed by Galaxy Commander Ramiel \"Warbear\" Bekker and named for the Grecian nymph in the Terran constellation of Ursa Major, the Callisto was designed to correct a tactical deficiency in the Rasalhague Dominion's infantry. The development resulted in two near identical versions of the Battle Armor, with only serial numbers and machining details being the only major differentiation between the two. The Callisto is based on the time tested Elemental Battle Suit making it a both recognizable, if a bit peculiar sight, and easy for warriors to switch to should the need arise. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The ultralight OmniMech Celerity was initially ComStar's attempt at creating an expendable drone reconnaissance BattleMech right after the Battle of Tukayyid. After the Fortress Protocols were activated, the Republic of the Sphere began experimenting with the Celerity as a means of expanding its military technology. They created a true OmniMech version of the Celerity to expand upon its utility and used it extensively on raids across their borders in the Dark Age era, causing endless confusion as to the identity of the parties using them.

content.content: Сверхлёгкий омнимех «Целерити» изначально был попыткой КомСтара создать одноразовый разведывательный дрон сразу после битвы на Туккайиде. После активации Протоколов Крепости Республика Сферы начала экспериментировать с «Целерити» как с инструментом расширения своих военных технологий. Они создали полноценную версию «Целерити» в формате омнимеха, чтобы расширить его возможности, и активно использовали его в рейдах вдоль своих границ в Тёмную эру.

content.original: Designed in secrecy, the Centaur is a Heavy-weight battle armor, first designed for the Republic of the Sphere's armed forces during the later Dark Age era. This was part of an effort by the Republic to develop a highly mobile battle armor-scale artillery piece. It was first built on Devil's Rock at the highly secretive Rhodes Foundry Ltd. factory, along with other secret projects. The battle armor first entered production in 3136 along with the Simian battle armor, and they would often be teamed up in the years ahead. Quirk: Experimental Design Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount any unit, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: Cuchulainn Support Armor was named for a hero from Irish mythology and was the product of a joint program between Clan Wolf-in-Exile and the Kell Hounds. Limited to moving at just over 10 km/h while carrying its Detachable Weapon Pack, Cuchulainn suits were designed to provide direct firepower support to other battle armor units, engaging enemy units at long range while lighter suits swarmed units that attempted to get close to the Cuchulainns. Almost half a ton of improved stealth armor helped protect the Cuchulainns while they engaged the enemy at range, but while the Cuchulainn mounted a Basic Manipulator on each arm and could ride on mechanized transport it was incapable of making swarm or leg attacks. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.952 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The increased presence of Sea Fox traders on Son Hoa has lead to the introduction of the ClanTech-equipped -7R/SF. The 'Mech seems lacking compared to the -7R, but this is intentional; its multiple ammo bins and eclectic weaponry make it well-suited to address a wide range of garrison contingencies (albeit in an unfocused, jack-of-all-trades fashion). The variant is commonly sold via Son Hoa’s hiring hall to Periphery merc units that can’t afford Omni technology or need a versatile anchor unit for urban deployments; the nearby Sea Fox offices offer payment plans of varying degrees of onerousness.

The variant is commonly sold via Son Hoa’s hiring hall to Periphery merc units that can’t afford Omni technology or need a versatile anchor unit for urban deployments; the nearby Sea Fox offices offer payment plans of varying degrees of onerousness.

content.original: The GLD-9SF mounts varied equipment to enable the machine to douse fires, weld seams, lift over 100 tons, and otherwise appear as a mundane spaceport IndustrialMech — an illusion quickly dispelled with one look at its right arm and its ER PPC. When moving cargo, pilots can use a special diagnostic computer mode that runs the shoulder-mounted flamers in a repeating activation cycle, automatically keeping the 'Mech's enhanced myomers active and giving the -9SF the appearance of a steam-age automaton with a flame-spouting smokestack. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The increased presence of Sea Fox traders on Son Hoa has lead to the introduction of the unusual -9SF. Only produced by special request, the -9SF is almost always seen in Shoal Clusters (where it is considered a somewhat better prospect for glory in battle than most IndustrialMechs). Some merchants bring them on trade ships to increase cargo space by combining BattleMech and IndustrialMech capabilities in a single bay, but finding pilots can be difficult; few Trueborn warriors are willing to be perceived as glorified stevedores, leaving freeborn, solahma, or contract pilots as the go-to options for such expeditions.

content.original: The Grenadier II battle armor suit is an evolution of the Grenadier suit already in use by the AFFS. It uses lighter Clan-spec Standard Stealth armor mated to an Inner Sphere chassis to save weight. This allows the Grenadier II to pack as much firepower and protection as a Grenadier, but at a lighter weight. In addition, the lighter weight of the Grenadier II means it can be transported by OmniMechs. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Боевой бронекостюм «Гренадер II» — это усовершенствованный вариант «Гренадера», уже используемого ВСФС. Он имеет клановую облегчённую стандартную стелс-броню, соединённую с шасси Внутренней Сферы для снижения веса. Это позволяет «Гренадеру II» обладать такой же огневой мощью и защитой, как «Гренадер», но при меньшем весе. Кроме того, меньший вес «Гренадера II» позволяет перевозить его на омнимехах. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.892 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Harpagos is a Clan Hell's Horses' heavy BattleMech designed for long-range combat. Armed with two Gauss rifles, the Harpagos can deliver devastating pinpoint damage at extreme ranges. While lacking jump jets, it boasts a top speed of 64 km/h, enabling it to reposition and maintain distance from its enemies. Its armor is also thick enough to withstand enemy attacks, making it a formidable opponent on the battlefield. However, the Harpagos has a large profile and is relatively slow compared to other heavy BattleMechs. Pilots must use careful positioning and cover to ensure its survival, while making use of its Gauss rifles to strike at enemies from afar. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: Commander, the Harpagos is a heavy BattleMech developed by Clan Hell's Horses. It's armed with two Gauss rifles, capable of dealing massive amounts of damage to its targets from long range. However, due to its lack of jump jets, it's not as mobile as some other BattleMechs. It has a top speed of 64 km/h, which is decent for its weight class. Its heavy armor and firepower make it a great choice for a front-line combat unit.

content.original: The Hel is noted for its large 40 ton Omni Pod Capacity. This improvement was achieved through reducing the size of the 'Mech's engine to a 260-Rated XL Fusion Engine, installing a Small Cockpit, and the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Prime Configuration of the Loki is geared towards long-range combat. The 'Mech's arms are fitted with a pair of Gauss Rifles and ER Large Lasers. In closer ranges, MechWarriors have a right torso mounted 4-tubed Streak SRM Launcher to add additional firepower where the Gauss Rifles become difficult to aim. The main guns are supplied with 3 tons of ammunition, while the Streak launcher is allotted a single ton. Two additional Double Heat Sinks are fitted to the Prime, to help it cope with the heat of the ER Larges.

content.original: Built by Luthien Armor Works of New Samarkand, the Hitotsume Kozo is a medium BattleMech designed to serve in the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery. This 'Mech's creation was partially influenced by an unofficial cultural rebirth. Keeping this in mind, LAW styled the appearance of the Hitotsume Kozo after the ancient Japanese Bushido armor worn by the samurai warriors during that time period on Terra. It received a poor reception by front-line troops due its advanced features and high heat output; however, it was appreciated when transferred to less-favored combat units, such as Ghost Regiments, as these less-fickle warriors adapted to the design's quirks and turned it into an effective combat unit. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
content.content: «Хитосуне Козо», построенный компанией Luthien Armor Works на Новом Самарканде, представляет собой средний боевой мех, предназначенный для службы в составе мобилизованных солдат Синдиката Дракона. На создание этого меха отчасти повлияло неофициальное культурное возрождение. Учитывая это, LAW стилизовали внешний вид Hitotsume Kozo по образцу древних японских доспехов бусидо, которые носили самураи в тот период на Терре. Он был плохо принят войсками на передовой из-за высокой теплоотдачи и ряда особенностей; однако он был оценен по достоинству при передаче менее популярным боевым подразделениям, таким как Призрачные полки, поскольку эти менее капризные воины адаптировались к специфики конструкции и превратили его в эффективную боевую единицу. Особенность: Стабильный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.

content.original: Produced jointly by Victory Conditions Industries and Eris Enterprises, the Jackalope represented a leap forward in anti-missile and recon technology. Designed to serve in recon and pursuit lances, this compact and swift BattleMech was used to full effect in combat, and additionally served as a training 'Mech and as an arena combat 'Mech. The 'Mech gets its name from a mythical animal which was said to have existed on Terra's North American continent.

content.content: Разработанный совместно компаниями Victory Conditions Industries и Eris Enterprises, «Джакалоп» представлял собой прорыв в технологиях противоракетной обороны и разведки. Этот компактный и быстрый боевой мех, предназначенный для использования в разведывательных и преследовательских копьях, эффективно применялся в бою, а также служил учебным мехом и мехом для боев на арене. Название происходит от мифического животного, которое, как говорят, обитало на североамериканском континенте Терры.

content.original: The JLP-KB was inspired by the personalized Jackalope of a Ghost Knight sent to operate outside the Fortress Wall. As the Republic braced for the Clan invasion of Terra, the Jackalope was overhauled to accept one of the few successful innovations from the Republic Institute for Strategic Combat - the advanced point defense system. The APDS fit naturally, given the Jackalope had originally been built around the Clan Laser Anti-Missile System; however, the bulk of this new system required engineers to use a small cockpit, making this variant a significantly less comfortable ride for its MechWarriors Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Kage (translating to "shadow" in japanese) light battle armor was one of the first battle armor designs produced by the Draconis Combine after the Truce of Tukayyid. Built for reconnaissance and battlefield infiltration, development of the Kage was a joint operation between Internal Security Force scientists and Draconis Elite Strike Team advisers. Indeed the Kage was meant to provide an alternative to the much-respected DEST Infiltration Suit for missions in which DEST teams could expect heavy opposition, and since production started in 3056 the battle armor has virtually replaced the older Sneak Suit. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Лёгкая боевая броня «Каге» (что в переводе с японского означает «тень») была одним из первых образцов боевой брони, созданных Синдикатом Дракона после Туккаидского перемирия. Разработанная для разведки и проникновения на поле боя, «Каге» стала совместной операцией учёных Сил Внутренней Безопасности и советников Элитной ударной группы Дракона (DEST). «Каге» задумывался как альтернатива высоко ценимому Infiltration бронекостюму DEST для миссий, в которых отряды DEST могли ожидать серьёзного сопротивления, и с начала производства в 3056 году эта боевая броня фактически заменила устаревший Sneak Suit. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Leonidas battle armor was a product of Etna Foundries and was intended to plug a capability gap in the armed forces of the Duchy of Oriente, a gap created by scarcity of the older Achileus stealth suit. The Leonidas suit is highly configurable, capable of being reconfigured for various battlefield missions including providing positional information, calling in artillery strikes, waging counterinsurgency warfare and conducting ambushes; the various roles are made possible through the different weapons and equipment loadouts available via the Modular Weapon Mount. Quirk: Information Gatherer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня «Леонид» была разработана компанией Etna Foundries и должна была восполнить пробел в вооруженных силах герцогства Ориенте, возникший из-за нехватки более старого стелс-костюма «Ахиллес». Костюм Leonidas обладает высокой степенью гибкости и может быть перенастроен для выполнения различных задач на поле боя, включая предоставление информации о местоположении, нанесение артиллерийских ударов, ведение противоповстанческой войны и организацию засад; различные роли возможны благодаря различным вариантам вооружения и снаряжения, доступным через модульное крепление оружия. Особенность: Information Gatherer Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.89 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Quirk: Information Gatherer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.

content.content: Несмотря на удивительное внешнее сходство с Timberwolf, этот боевой мех - новое и мощное творение. Несущий тринадцать тонн ферроволоконной брони, Mad Cat MK II - невероятно прочная конструкция. Пара установленных в руках пушек Гаусса, поддерживаемые LRM, обеспечивают ему полное господство на поле боя.

content.original: The Malice appears to be on its way towards becoming one of the premier mercenary assault 'Mechs of the age. Seen most often in the Galatean Defense Force and the Republic Armed Forces, the Malice has seen a lot of action for such a recent addition to the battlefield. Very fast for an assault 'Mech, topping out around 64 km/h, this brute can bring a withering barrage of autocannon fire to bear. Protected by more than nineteen tons of standard armor, the Malice can remain in combat for a long time.

content.original: This Malice variant uses the best technology available to both the Inner Sphere and the Clans. The top speed drops to 54 km/h, but an XXL engine is used to free up large amounts of weight. A Clan spec Endo Steel chassis is used to hold the engine, while a Compact Gyro frees up room in the center torso. Both the engine and gyro are Armored Components as are the hips. Improved protection is provided by Ferro-Lamellor armor, backed up by Modular Armor on the arms, legs, and front torso locations. The left and right torsos also use integrated CASE provided by Clan engineers. An Angel ECM Suite, Clan TAG system, and C3 Slave are available for electronic warfare support. The Malice-YZ carries a torso mounted Remote Sensor Dispensers as well. For additional protection against missiles, a Clan built Laser AMS is carried in each arm. Offensively, each arm carries a Clan built Large Pulse Laser and the left and right torsos each have a single Clan made ER Large Laser. Twelve double heat sinks work hard to manage the heat load but if they are overwhelmed there are two Coolant Pods available to the pilot to get a quick cooldown. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Nighthawk is a PA(L) design and the progenitor of modern battle armor. The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.884 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: One of the most notable attributes of the Night Stalker NSR-K3 is its speed. Powered by its 320 XL extralight engine, the 40 ton design can quickly close distance between it and its objective. In its role as a recon and pursuit 'Mech, the Night Stalker is fitted with a Beagle active probe to find hidden units. Other design features include a torso-mounted cockpit and TAG - the latter of which can be used to call in artillery support. Protecting the 'Mech's hull are six and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Night Stalker's arsenal is meant for intermediate and close-in fighting, with a pair of right arm-mounted ER medium lasers and an SRM-6 in the left torso. Upon entering close range, the 'Mech can bring its ER small laser and small pulse laser to bear on a potential target. In combination with the Night Stalker' speed, a MechWarrior can use its unusually-shaped left arm-mounted lance to pierce an enemy's armor. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.content: Одним из самых заметных атрибутов Night Stalker NSR-K3 является его скорость. Благодаря сверхлегкому двигателю 320 XL, 40-тонный мех может быстро сократить расстояние между собой и целью. «Ночной сталкер» оснащён активным зондом Beagle для поиска скрытых объектов. Среди других особенностей конструкции - установленная в торсе кабина и TAG. TAG может использоваться для вызова артиллерийской поддержки. Корпус меха защищают шесть с половиной тонн ферроволоконной брони. Арсенал Night Stalker предназначен для ведения боя на промежуточных и ближних дистанциях: пара средних лазеров в правой руке и SRM-6 в левой. При выходе на ближнюю дистанцию мех может навести на потенциальную цель свой малый лазер и малый импульсный лазер. В сочетании со скоростью «Ночного сталкера» мехвоин может использовать копье необычной формы, установленное в левой руке, чтобы пробить броню противника. Особенность: Отвлекающий Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.02

The first original BattleMech produced by Victory Conditions Industries on Mizar, the Night Stalker was first unveiled in the arenas of Solaris VII, where it would gather a reputation that propelled the company’s sales to success. The design would soon see service with the Federated Suns, the Lyran Commonwealth, mercenary units, and among all the nation states of the Inner Sphere.

content.original: The Notos is an advanced Heavy-class hybrid between a Quadrupedal OmniMech and Combat Vehicle design, known more simply as a QuadVee, introduced by Clan Hell's Horses. Named after the Greek Goddess of the south wind, the Notos is a more refined QuadVee design in comparison to its earlier predecessors. Retaining the best qualities of the previous models, the machine has been built to support a diverse array of weapon and equipment configurations, while also taking advantage of using wheels in place of tank treads. The Notos can call upon 15 tons worth of equipment allowed by its omnipods. While it sports a modest 12.5 tons of standard armor protection from enemy fire, its true innovation comes with its unique ability: transformation into a combat vehicle. Powered by a 300-Rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine, the vehicular Notos can travel at up to a swift 95 km/h, while in 'Mech mode it can move at a solid 80 km/h. This high speed gives it the capability to keep pace with fast combat formations. Unlike its predecessors, the Notos can move significantly faster over flat terrain thanks to its incorporation of wheels rather than tank treads.

content.original: The Nyx is a light BattleMech originally developed by the Word of Blake in the late Jihad. The Blakists' designs for the 'Mech and a prototype were captured by the Allied Coalition's Draconis Combine force on Quentin in 3077,[4] and were rushed off to the Draconis Combine's Diplan MechYards, where engineers did not have the resources to put the advanced design into production. After the liberation of Terra in 3079, the Combine would ask aide from the new Terran government to assist with development of the 'Mech. It would be jointly produced by both the Republic and Combine, prior to the very end of the Jihad. The design was conceived as a speedy recon 'Mech, with a 300 XL engine allowing it to reach 162 km/h.

content.original: Originally developed in the thirty-second century as a replacement for the Raiden suit, the Oni was considered an ugly and generally unimpressive battlesuit by the majority of the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery, and was generally issued to either garrison units or units suffering the disfavor of the Procurement Department. Despite the problems with the Oni - perceived or actual - the suit has continued to be a presence in militia units throughout the first half of the thirty-second century, in part because of the third of a ton of Clan-spec fire resistant armor the Oni mounts. content.original: This Wolf Empire variant is a much more thorough melding of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies. Built around a few central Inner Sphere-grade components - a 270-rated XL engine, seven standard jump jets, and an endo steel frame - while clad in five and a half tons of Clan-grade ferro-fibrous armor. Now better armored than the original and capable of a remarkable 151 km/h top speed, the Pack Hunter 5's sole weapon is the Clan-tech ER PPC that gave the original model its bite. Though this means the 5 is still plagued by the original's inability to engage multiple opponents, the sheer speed gained in this upgrade makes it ever easier to avoid most return fire. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble.

content.content: «Пак Хантер» — первый новый проект, созданный кланом Волка-в-изгнании на Арк-Ройяле. Он также представляет собой результат нового партнёрства между Волками Фелана и Гончими Келла, поскольку броня и средства связи изготовлены Гончими и были переданы Волкам в обмен на эндосталь. Следуя за стремлением их хана к лёгким и быстрым конструкциям, учёные Волка разработали Pack Hunter таким образом, чтобы он был быстрым и обладал болючим укусом. Несмотря на лёгкость четырёхтонной брони, этот боевой мех должен использовать свою скорость и манёвренность, чтобы оставаться в стороне от неприятностей.

content.original: Based on the standard Purifier suit, the primary difference is the removal of the mimetic armor and its replacement with Clan standard armor identical to that used on the Elemental suit. The Purifier Terra uses a Modular Weapon Mount to provide a variety of weapons options. The Coalition encountered variants equipped with Clan level ER Small Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and AP Gauss Rifle. Other variants used a Medium Recoilless Rifle. Beyond that, any equipment that could fit into a 400kg MWM could be carried. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Основное отличие от стандартного костюма Purifier заключается в отсутствии адаптивной брони и её замене на стандартную клановую, идентичной той, что используется в костюме «Элементалов». Purifier Terra использует модульное оружейное крепление (MWM), предоставляющее широкий выбор оружия. Коалиция столкнулась с вариантами, оснащёнными клановым малым ER-лазером, малым импульсным лазером и бронебойной винтовкой Гаусса. Другие варианты использовали среднюю безоткатную винтовку. Кроме того, можно было нести любое снаряжение, помещающееся в 400-килограммовое MWM. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.87 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Produced on Terra by StarCorp Industries, the Quirinus is a late thirty-first century Medium battle armor which was originally produced for general sale. Developed as a mainline trooper in the early years of the Republic Era, the Quirinus was sold initially to the fractured Free Worlds League. While not as flashy as many of its contemporaries of its time, the suit is known for its reliability and as a good unit in the field. The battle armor would find its way into hands of mercenary units and elements of the Republic of the Sphere. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Квиринус», производимый на Терре компанией StarCorp Industries, — это средний боевой доспех конца 31-го века, изначально выпускавшийся для широкой продажи. Разработанный как основной боевой доспех в первые годы эры Республики, «Квиринус» изначально продавался раздробленной Лиге Свободных Миров. Хотя он не такой броский, как многие его современники, этот костюм известен своей надёжностью и эффективностью в полевых условиях. Этот боевой доспех впоследствии попал в руки наёмных отрядов, а также подразделений Республики Сферы. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.89 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

The battle armor would find its way into hands of mercenary units and elements of the Republic of the Sphere.

content.original: The Raider JL-1 is an ICE-powered BattleMech, while its internal construction is similar to contemporaries of its tonnage. Its 200-rated ICE gives the 'Mech a modest maximum speed of 64.8 km/h, but if the MechWarrior piloting it is able to manage the 'Mech's heat output correctly, they should be able to engage the Raider's military-grade TSM to move the Raider to a faster top speed of 86.4 km/h and become more effective in close range combat. The JL-1 is fitted with seven tons of standard armor to give the Raider protection most IndustrialMechs would envy. Its arsenal of weaponry is limited to a pair of MRM-10 launchers mounted in the right torso, with single ton of ammunition, and a dual saw mounted on its left arm actuator. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

The design was created as a means to skirt around Republic of the Sphere restrictions on military hardware under the project name ''Jacob's Ladder'', and Bannson's technical and engineering teams would utilize whatever technology they could access to reach their goal. The resulting design turned out to be not necessarily a failure, with the Raider proving to be a commercial success when it first appeared on the battlefields by 3134.

content.original: The Mark II JL-2 variant of the Raider owes its development to Bannson Industries R&D team's success with the development of their own RAC/2. Though not included in the original design due to weight issues, the weapon design was too good to drop completely. The autocannon gives the Mk. II more accurate firepower at long ranges, while the standard model was forced to use a modest ranged and slightly inaccurate weapon for ranged attacks. The installation of the autocannon and its two tons of ammunition would necessitate the removal of the original MRM-10 and associated ammunition, as well as downgrading the engine to a 150-rated engine. This thus reduced the Mech's maximum speed of 50 km/h, while however under certain conditions, it would be able to reach the original design's standard maximum running speed while using TSM. However, the engine reduction would prove to be a boon to the variant's armor protection, where its protection was bolstered to 10 tons of standard armor. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: Based on specs from Operation Trapdoor, the 45 ton Rattlesnake II is a 10 ton upgrade of the original Rattlesnake Mech. Built by Clan Sea Fox for the AFFS during the waning years of the Dark Age, the RSN-1 is powered by a 315-rated Clan XL Engine. 8 tons of Clan Ferro-Fibrous armor and a Guardian ECM suite protect the Mech while Clan MASC increases the Mechs ground speed. A pair of Clan ER Medium Lasers backed up a quartet of Medium Lasers form the bulk of the Mechs arsenal with an ER Small Laser rounding out the weapons. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Rhino's ranged weapons consist of a quintet of Extended Range Medium Lasers. Two are mounted in each foreleg, and the fifth is in the head. The reason for this unusual configuration is due to the inclusion of a Ram Plate, which occupies much of the forward torso and prevents the mounting of other weapons there. The weapon is used for charge attacks, and is supplemented by an array of spikes. To support the Ram Plate, the Rhino is equipped with a reinforced chassis. The BattleMech is protected by nine tons of Clan Ferro-Fibrous armor. In order to enable its charge attacks, it is powered by a 300 Extralight Fusion Engine, giving it a top speed of 96 km/h. This is further augmented by a MASC system that allows it to reach bursts of 130 km/h for short periods. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: Designed with minimal weaponry, the RK-4K's only ranged weapon is its ER PPC, mounted in the 'Mech's left arm. Once the 'Mech reaches melee range it can use its deadly katana-like sword in its right hand. To allow the Rokurokubi to survive enemy fire while closing in to enable its MechWarrior to use the melee weapon, the 'Mech is armored with 13.5 tons of hardened armor. Despite the weight of the armor slowing the 'Mech by about 10 km/h, its 245-rated XL engine is able to give the Rokurokubi a respectable top speed of 108 km/h. However, the pilot must be mindful that his armor protection is not foolproof and a hit to the central torso could end up damaging the 'Mech's fragile XL gyro. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

content.original: The Rokurokubi is a light BattleMech built for the armed forces of the Draconis Combine and was styled after ancient Japanese bushido armor. Designed to be a light strike 'Mech, the Rokurokubi uses its speed and robust armor to close with an enemy unit while employing its singular ranged weapon until it can bring its sword to bear. The 'Mech was popular among the young samurai of House Kurita, who used it for honor duels between warriors in addition to regular combat.

content.original: The SH-1V can fight at all ranges, with the 'Mech's main weaponry consisting of four LRM 10 Launchers located in its central torso. The launchers use Clan technologies, which allows the 'Mech to fire its missiles at all ranges with 3 tons of ammunition. Backing up these ranged weapons is a single LB-2X Autocannon which is found in its left arm actuator. Intended to fight up front with rest of Combine frontline troops, the 'Mech's right arm is fitted with a Sword which is styled similarly to a naginata polearm. Powered by a 375-rated XL Fusion Engine and balanced by an XL Gyro, the 'Mech possesses a modest maximum speed of 75 km/h. 'Mechs are normally faster with such an engine, but this 'Mech is slowed slightly due to its 21 tons of Hardened Armor. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Shiro BattleMech was originally produced for the Draconis Combine's armed forces. Named for House Kurita's founder, Shiro Kurita, the Shiro was made to embody the spirit of bushido, the Way of the Warrior, its armor designed to resemble the Samurai armor of ancient Japan. When it was first presented to the DCMS, it was ordered only to those who are acclaimed and honor would be granted with the chance to pilot the Shiro.

content.original: The Shockwave was created by the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth in the years after the Jihad. Its high top speed, strong armor, and powerful weapons make it a popular choice around the Inner Sphere. Mobile and heavily-armed for a 50-ton 'Mech, the Shockwave can deliver a withering barrage and has the heat-sinks to keep it up almost indefinitely. The use of standard armor and commonly employed weapons allows the Shockwave to be used on nearly any battlefield.

content.original: The Simian is a thirty-second century medium battle armor which was the brain child of Republic of the Sphere Paladin, Kara Rutherford. The design came about due in part to Paladin Rutherford's concern of the high cost of battle armor development. Her efforts to make a cost-effective design would give birth to the Simian, however, she would not live to see it enter production. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.868 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Симиан» — средняя боевая броня, созданная в тридцать втором веке паладином Республики Сферы Карой Резерфорд. Идея создания этой брони отчасти была обусловлена ​​обеспокоенностью паладина Резерфорд высокой стоимостью разработки боевых доспехов. Её стремление создать экономичную конструкцию привело к появлению Simian, однако она не дожила до его запуска в производство. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.868 Может крепиться на любом юните, может в ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: A prototype OmniMech built on the success of the Stormcrow line, fielded by Clan Wolf for trials before going into full production. Using a combination of a 330-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine and TSM, the 'Mech is able to achieve speeds up to 110 km/h. Perhaps the most startling innovation included in this design is the Clan Interface Armor, which allows a MechWarrior to interface with their 'Mech while being completely armored should they be forced to eject. This combination interface allows the Ryoken III pilot's a degree of control in combat, and removes the need to have a Gyro mounted in the 'Mech. This technology was thought to have been lost at the time of Skinwalker's baptism in combat by Inner Sphere powers. In addition to having its pilot encased in a power-armor interface, the Mech's hull is protected by 11.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor Armor.

content.content: Прототип омнимеха, созданный на основе успешной линейки Stormcrow, использовался кланом Волка для испытаний перед запуском в производство. Используя комбинацию сверхлегкого термоядерного двигателя рейтинга 330 и TSM, этот омнимех способен развивать скорость до 110 км/ч. Пожалуй, самым поразительным новшеством в этой конструкции является клановая интерфейсная броня, которая позволяет мехвоину взаимодействовать со своим мехом и при этом быть полностью бронированным в своей кабине. Этот интерфейс позволяет пилоту Ryoken III контролировать ситуацию в бою и избавляет его от необходимости устанавливать гироскоп на меха. Считалось, что эта технология была утеряна во время боевого крещения Skinwalker против сил Внутренней Сферы. Помимо того, что пилот окружён усиленной бронёй, корпус меха защищен 11,5 тоннами ферро-ламеллярной брони.

content.original: Fast, quick, and deadly, the B configuration is fitted with medium and short range weapons and a Supercharger to help it get into range. The arsenal includes five Improved Heavy Medium Lasers. These weapons are fitted in the side, center torsos and right arm. The main weapon for close-up combat is a Class-20 Ultra Autocannon mounted on the right arm, with three tons of ammunition protected by CASE II. Enhancing the Mech's survival is a Clan-produced ECM suite. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Surtur is a close range attacker, so engineers fitted the design with an extra light fusion engine to push the 'Mech to 90 km/h, with added supercharger for additional temporary boost in speed to 120 km/h. The 'Mech's armor protection includes twelve tons of standard armor to help survive an onslaught of longer range fire so it can intercept its target. Its firepower includes two standard side torso mounted 6-tubed Short-Range Missile Launchers with 1 ton of ammunition feeding from center torso. Energy weapons include seven Flamers, three found in the side torsos and single flamer in left arm. Its signature melee weapon mounted in the right arm is a sword. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

By 3120s, the League industrial/technology levels had achieved pre-Jihad level of technology. The governing Merchant Council decided it was time of the reason was pride in their nation's achievement, as indigenous design should be made. The Surtur is designed as a skirmisher, intended to get into close-quarters combat to render the enemies.

content.original: Produced on Shitara for The Republic of the Sphere, the Thunderbird II battle armor is an upgrade of the Thunderbird battle armor produced by Clan Nova Cat expats. The modular weapons mount of the original were replaced with a Detachable Weapon Pack in each arm. The left arm carries a single AP Gauss Rifle while the right arm carries a LB-X (Battle Armor). Reflective armor protects the Thunderbird II. What makes it so deadly in the Republic Armed Forces is the integrated Battle Armor C3 system. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.955 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня «Буревестник II», произведенная на заводе Shitara для Республики Сферы, представляет собой усовершенствованную версию боевой брони Thunderbird, созданной экспатами клана Нова Кота. Модульное оружейное крепление оригинальной брони было заменено съёмным оружейным комплектом в каждой руке. В левой руке установлена ​​одна противопехотная винтовка Гаусса, а в правой — LB-X (боевой брони). «Тандербёрд II» защищён отражающей броней. Интегрированная система C3 для боевой брони делает его смертоносным в Вооружённых силах Республики. Особенность: Удачный дизайн Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.955 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Tian-zong is a post-Jihad design that the Capellan Confederation first developed in 3090. Equipped with thirteen and a half tons of Stealth Armor powered by an Angel ECM Suite, the Tian-zong is a premier 'Recon in Force' 'Mech. The 300-rated extralight engine propels the Tian-zong to a top speed of 64 km/h, which can make for a jarring ride given the Small Cockpit. The Tian-zong is one of the first Capellan 'Mechs to use an Endo-Composite skeleton. Twelve Double Heat Sinks dissipate the heat from the Stealth Armor. It is a popular 'Mech with CCAF commanders.

content.original: The Tolva is fitted with nine-and-a-half tons of standard BattleMech armor. Its quadruped leg configuration also gives it considerable stability as it traverses rough terrain and added stability for MechWarriors. Unlike its progenetor design it has five jump jets to cover 150 meters at a time, and mounts three extra heat sinks. The 'Mech is powered by a 200-rated fusion engine, giving the Tolva sufficient mobility for it to keep up with supporting forces. Mounted on a turret in the right torso, the Tolva's main guns come in the form of three Clan-produced ER Medium Lasers. These Clan-grade lasers are supplemented by an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing it to make each shot count. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: The Tomahawk is an assault-class OmniMech designed by Clan Wolf in 3065. By September of that year, a few prototypes had been built and were being tested in trial runs. One these prototypes was piloted by Nathan Wolf in a Circle of Equals on Tamar when he attained the rank of Star Colonel. Although he was victorious against a Thor, it was noted that the Tomahawk still suffered from numerous system errors and gremlins and was not yet ready for mass production. Still, Nathan retained the 'Mech for his subsequent assignment to Omega Galaxy and successfully piloted it in combat on Novo Cressidas in the Star's End system on 11 April 3064.
