The best theories offered to date both converge on the idea that Rapunzel is a work in progress. Особенность: Боевой компьютер Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06

content.original: Debuted in 3144 on the Hartford Gardens Arena and piloted by Penny O'Hara, Watchman Belle is an experiment in bringing master-and-drone technology into the realm of BattleMech dueling. This 'Mech features a type of modified command console that allows a copilot to control a heavyweight drone — a Vulpes refit nicknamed the Beast. 'Mech armament is completely changed, with a quartet of ER medium lasers that support a single Large Re-Engineered Laser. This combination of firepower taxes the ’Mech’s twelve Double Heat Sinks. Seven tons of ferro-fibrous armor protect the 'Mech. The 'Mech adds a Clan Watchdog System electronics package. This effective blend of active probe and ECM hardware not only allows Belle to disrupt her adversaries’ sensors, but also serves as a powerful counter-countermeasures suite, that can punch through hostile interference that might otherwise render her Beast a very expensive and impotent statue. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.content: Дебютировавший в 3144 году на арене Хартфорд Гарденс под управлением Пенни О'Хара, Watchman Belle - это эксперимент по внедрению технологии «хозяин и дрон» в область дуэльных матчей на боевых мехах. Этот мех оснащен модифицированной командной консолью, которая позволяет второму пилоту управлять тяжелым дроном - переоборудованным Vulpes по прозвищу «Зверь». Вооружение меха полностью изменено: квартет средних ER-лазеров, которые поддерживают один большой Re-Engineered лазер. Такая комбинация огневой мощи обслуживается 12 двойными охладителями. Мех защищают семь тонн ферро-волоконной брони. Мех оснащен электронным блоком Clan Watchdog System. Такое эффективное сочетание активного зона и ECM-аппаратуры не только позволяет «Белле» выводить из строя сенсоры противника, но и служит мощным комплексом контрмер, способным пробиться сквозь вражеские помехи, которые в противном случае превратили бы её «Зверя» в очень дорогую и бессильную статую. Особенность: Легко управлять Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.04

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: Another Earthwerks-FWL developed model, this variant was produced on Keystone.[63] An Inner Sphere XL engine and endo steel chassis were fitted with multiple Clan-spec systems. Like the traditional Phoenix Hawk, this version carries a Clan medium pulse laser and AP Gauss rifle in each arm. The right arm also carries a Clan large pulse laser. All these weapons are tied into a Clan-built targeting computer. What makes this version stand out is the supercharger which allows the 'Mech to reach 120 km/h Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The Prefect was an ammo-independent Republic of the Sphere BattleMech, designed specifically for guerrilla combat. With increasing legal tensions between the newborn Republic and military manufacturers who suffered heavy damage at the hands of Stone's Coalition during Operation SCOUR, Exarch Devlin Stone commissioned a new BattleMech intended to create jobs, bolster his military, and to stave off the worst of the lawsuits. While ultimately unsuccessful on the last count, the well-regarded Prefect would enter service with the public RAF as well as black ops units. Mandating a simple, fast and durable energy weapon design based on the guerrilla-style warfare he conducted in the early years of resistance to the Blakists, Stone was forced to make a number of concessions and include a more expensive Endo Steel chassis along with ferro-fibrous armor, as well as the more fragile Light Fusion Engine and XL Gyro in an attempt to win over the military-industrial complex.

content.original: The Warwolf is a Heavy Class OmniMech, first produced by Clan Wolf during the mid-thirty-second century. Conceived as a part of Clan Wolf's movement to replace their old signature Timber Wolf, the Warwolf was designed to be a flexible cavalry unit. Powered by the Timber Wolf's 375-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine, the Warwolf shares its predecessor's flexible speed. Using the weight savings of the XL Engine and the strength of its endo-steel construction, the Warwolf is able to carry 30 tons worth of OmniPod weapons and equipment. The 'Mech is protected by 14.5 tons of Clan grade reactive armor, giving the Warwolf the ability to ward off explosive type weaponry while retaining the strength of standard armor. In addition to the Warwolf's armor, the 'Mech uses a Laser-based Anti-Missile System to help fight off incoming missile attacks.

content.content: «Варвульф» — это омнимех тяжёлого класса, впервые произведённый кланом Волка в середине тридцать второго века. Задуманный как часть плана клана Волка по замене их старого фирменного Timber Wolf, Warwolf был разработан как гибкий кавалерийский юнит. Работающий на двигателе XL375, Warwolf имеет скорость своего предшественника. Используя экономию веса XL двигателя и прочность своей эндо-стальной конструкции, Warwolf способен нести 30 тонн оружия и оборудования. Мех защищён 14,5 тоннами клановой реактивной брони, что даёт Warwolf возможность отражать оружие взрывного типа, сохраняя при этом прочность стандартной брони. В дополнение к броне, мех использует лазерную противоракетную систему для отражения ракетных атак.

content.original: An intermediate fighter, the B Configuration has a limited number of weapons, while sporting five Jump Jets. Its main gun is an Ultra Class 10 Autocannon with three tons of ammunition, all mounted in the 'Mech's right arm. The 'Mech's only offensive energy weapon is an ER Large Pulse Laser, while a head-mounted LAMS provides defense against incoming missiles. Five additional Double Heat Sinks are fitted throughout the side torsos and left arm. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: A powerful and hard hitting configuration, the H represents the Warwolf's Heavy Laser–focused weapon layout. A pair of Improved Heavy Large Lasers are split between each of the 'Mech's side torsos, while the right arm is fitted with a Gauss rifle with sixteen rounds of ammunition. CASE II protects the 'Mech's right and left torsos in the event of a heavy laser capacitor explosion. To help cope with the extreme heat generated by the 'Mech's weapons, two additional Double Heat Sinks and a pair of Coolant Pods are added. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

content.content: Впервые представленный Терранской гегемонией в 2568 году, Phoenix Hawk был одним из самых известных боевых мехов во Внутренней Сфере. Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: A light combat vehicle that first saw production in 2692 the Galleon proved to be an economical means of supporting infantry and BattleMechs. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. content.original: A 28th century design that first saw production in 3058, the Dragon Fire is a 75-ton mech designed for brawling. The DRG-7K is armed with an ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle, with a Large VSPL and a pair of Medium Lasers as secondary weapons. A 300-rated XL Engine and an Endo-Steel Skeleton provide the weight needed for the heavy payload. Ballistic Reinforced Armour and a Supercharger improve survivability.

content.original: A light combat vehicle that first saw production in 2692 the Galleon proved to be an economical means of supporting infantry and BattleMechs. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Обладая максимальной скоростью, превышающей скорость большинства мехов, Galleon был мобилен, но не имел достаточной защиты: ранние модели несли всего три с половиной тонны брони. После Исхода эти гусеничные машины попали в основном в распоряжение Синдиката Дракона и Лиги Свободных Миров. Galleon часто используется в паре с ракетной платформой Harasser. Ограничения биома: нет. content.original: Not to be confused with the original Padilla, the Padilla Tube Artillery Tank was a Republic of the Sphere vehicle meant to fulfill a similar role. Originally designed and produced by Aldis Industries at the request of Precentor Martial Cameron St. Jamais, the Padilla Tube Artillery Tank serves as the main conventional artillery support platform used by the Republic Armed Forces. The Padilla is well-protected for a vehicle of its size. This is good as the tank's low top speed could make it an easy target for fast moving units or airstrikes. Biome Restrictions: None. Танк с трубчатой ​​артиллерией Padilla, изначально разработанный и произведенный компанией Aldis Industries по заказу военного регента Кэмерона Сент-Джамаиса, служит основной артиллерийской платформой поддержки, используемой Вооруженными силами Республики. content.original: The Schildkröte Line Tank is a Medium sized Combat Vehicle, originally designed for the Lyran Commonwealth's armed forces in 3122. A durable but slow tank, the Schildkröte was not well regarded when it first premiered. Due to this perception of it being too slow for frontline units, the vehicle was distributed among the Commonwealth's lower tier combat formations and planetary militia. However, over time the tank's durability would win over many with its performance in the field. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: A RISC variant of the antiquated BattleAxe, the BKX-RISC was rebuilt the from the ground up, retaining its core payload of paired particle projector cannons. Though Clan-grade weapons were available, the project lead chose not to waste them on a questionable BattleMech, opting instead for capacitors to enhance Inner Sphere ER PPCs. A RISC emergency cooling system was planned, but was sidelined in favor of the radical heat sink system. Though the resulting machine is dissimilar to Achernar's BKX-8D built on New Avalon, the choice was made to keep Federated Suns tech on a Federated Suns 'Mech in case it was captured Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-8D is a Jihad era revamp of the ancient design. Built around a 280-rated Light Engine, the BKX-8D is armed with a trio of MML-7’s, with 4 ER Medium Lasers as backup weapons.

content.content: Первый отечественный боевой мех, созданный ФедСолнцами, 70-тонный Battleaxe дебютировал в 2459 году. Основанный на технологии, использованной в Mackie, Battleaxe постоянно совершенствовался, внедряя новые технологии, прежде чем был снят с вооружения после Объединительной войны, когда на вооружение поступили более новые модели, такие как Hammerhands и Warhammer. Battleaxe BKX-8D — это переработанный вариант древнего проекта времён Джихада. BKX-8D, построенный на базе лёгкого двигателя рейтинга 280, вооружён тремя MML-7 и четырьмя средними ER-лазерами в качестве резервного оружия.

To keep the 'Mech's extreme levels of waste heat in check, a suite of RISC heat management systems was installed, alongside a customized combat computer like that found on the Stalker. content.original: Patterned after the sturdy Royal variant, the EXC-B2-RISC is optimized for headhunter and ambush missions. The centerpiece of its design is a First Star League-vintage null-signature system, sourced from former ComStar supply depots, which renders the unit largely immune to enemy target locks. Sporting a Clan-spec LRM launcher mated with an advanced Artemis-V guidance system, alongside the signature Gauss rifle, the EXC-B2-RISC can engage at standoff range to maximize its stealth advantage. While efficient use of its mobility, firepower and defensive systems should make overheating a rare concern, the extreme heat mitigation solutions employed by this 'Mech provide for an excellent low-risk technology demonstration. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The HEL-6RISC is completely reskinned with Chameleon LPS-integrated armor shaped to match common Capellan manufactured Helios variants. While the visual deception cannot fool a detailed scan, it is more than enough for the HEL-6RISC and its companions (either support drones or piloted units) to spring a crippling surprise strike. Though hot-running and offensively lackluster, this 'Mech is nonetheless effective in its role as a linchpin for black-ops ambush and raiding teams. content.original: Attempting to address the poor performance of the AES-enhanced TSEMPs on the Icarus II ICR-2R, the RISC selected the ICR-2S as a testbed for their prototype repeating TSEMP. They removed the autocannon to make it a mobile behind-the-lines raider without ammunition dependencies, but unlike the -2R, they retained the supporting weaponry from the -2S and a second medium pulse laser was installed alongside a targeting computer to enhance accuracy. The design team envisioned entire lances of the ICR-2X overwhelming Clan Stars and Capellan Shadow Lances with massed TSEMP barrages. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The LGN-2K-RISC is a relatively barebones refit that simply swaps the standard 2K's primary weapon and MASC suite for a Hyper laser and additional heat sinks. This gives the Hyper laser an accurate and mobile delivery platform, without altering the visual profile of the more mundane LGN-2K—a field refit. Specially trained teams of RISC technicians and pilots were formed that traveled only with the refit kit, then met with existing line units utilizing stock LGN-2Ks to execute special missions. This ability to play shell games with hyper lasers served the Republic relatively well, with verified or suspected instances of LGN-2K-RISC deployments being more widespread than the limited production of the hyper laser would otherwise allow. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The Legionnaire was developed as the Federated Suns answer to the Lyran Blitzkrieg, and entered production during the Word of Blake Jihad. A lance of Legionnaires played an important role in the Third Battle of New Avalon, where they quickly assaulted the Blakist force's left flank as they were attempting to ford the Thames river, breaking their momentum and eventually forcing them off world. Capable of reaching 118 km/h, the Legionnaire is a fast flanker.

content.content: «Легионер» был разработан Федеративными Солнцами как ответ на лиранский «Блицкриг» и поступил в производство во время Джихада Слова Блейка. Копьё легионеров сыграло важную роль в Третьей битве за Новый Авалон, где они стремительно атаковали левый фланг блейкистов, пытавшихся переправиться через Темзу, сломив их натиск и в конечном итоге вытеснив с планеты. Развивая скорость до 118 км/ч, «Легионер» — быстрый фланговик.

content.original: Intended to maximize the repeating TSEMP weapon's potential on a safer platform than the Icarus, the Templar ORISC configuration enhances the Davion-born Omni's offensive payload with additional experimental technology and advanced electronics to mitigate the TSEMP's less desirable side effects. In the field, raider Templars using this configuration typically assumed an outlying position relative to their formation's line-holder units, offering token fire support as they worked for better positions from which to deliver sustained TSEMP fire. As such, these 'Mechs could readily disable most opponents in under a minute, but the volatile nature of their RISC tech virtually ensured that some form of catastrophe could strike before then. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The primary configuration of the Templar is intended to be able to engage an enemy effectively at any range. For effective long range hitting power, the Templar carries a powerful Gauss Rifle. If the Templar does close with an enemy, it can bring its highly accurate Large Pulse Laser, Medium Pulse Laser, and two ER Medium Lasers to bear on a target. For increased accuracy, the Gauss Rifle and all the lasers are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer. The Templar Prime has a Streak SRM-4 launcher for seeking weak points in an enemy's armor.

content.original: Designed in the middle of the thirty-second century, the Wendigo is a Medium Class OmniMech designed and produced originally for Clan Nova Cat. The 'Mech's creation stems from the results of the Clan's prolonged efforts with Draconis Combine's Luthien Armor Works to produce a replacement design for its touman. The resulting Avalanche turned out to be less than what the Clan had hoped for, so using the basic premise of the Avalanche design, the results of Clan Scientists would become the Wendigo.

content.original: A RISC variant of the antiquated BattleAxe, the BKX-RISC was rebuilt the from the ground up, retaining its core payload of paired particle projector cannons. Though Clan-grade weapons were available, the project lead chose not to waste them on a questionable BattleMech, opting instead for capacitors to enhance Inner Sphere ER PPCs. A RISC emergency cooling system was planned, but was sidelined in favor of the radical heat sink system. Though the resulting machine is dissimilar to Achernar's BKX-8D built on New Avalon, the choice was made to keep Federated Suns tech on a Federated Suns 'Mech in case it was captured Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Patterned after the sturdy Royal variant, the EXC-B2-RISC is optimized for headhunter and ambush missions. The centerpiece of its design is a First Star League-vintage null-signature system, sourced from former ComStar supply depots, which renders the unit largely immune to enemy target locks. Sporting a Clan-spec LRM launcher mated with an advanced Artemis-V guidance system, alongside the signature Gauss rifle, the EXC-B2-RISC can engage at standoff range to maximize its stealth advantage. While efficient use of its mobility, firepower and defensive systems should make overheating a rare concern, the extreme heat mitigation solutions employed by this 'Mech provide for an excellent low-risk technology demonstration. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

While the visual deception cannot fool a detailed scan, it is more than enough for the HEL-6RISC and its companions (either support drones or piloted units) to spring a crippling surprise strike. Though hot-running and offensively lackluster, this 'Mech is nonetheless effective in its role as a linchpin for black-ops ambush and raiding teams. content.original: Attempting to address the poor performance of the AES-enhanced TSEMPs on the Icarus II ICR-2R, the RISC selected the ICR-2S as a testbed for their prototype repeating TSEMP. They removed the autocannon to make it a mobile behind-the-lines raider without ammunition dependencies, but unlike the -2R, they retained the supporting weaponry from the -2S and a second medium pulse laser was installed alongside a targeting computer to enhance accuracy. The design team envisioned entire lances of the ICR-2X overwhelming Clan Stars and Capellan Shadow Lances with massed TSEMP barrages. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The LGN-2K-RISC is a relatively barebones refit that simply swaps the standard 2K's primary weapon and MASC suite for a Hyper laser and additional heat sinks. This gives the Hyper laser an accurate and mobile delivery platform, without altering the visual profile of the more mundane LGN-2K—a field refit. Specially trained teams of RISC technicians and pilots were formed that traveled only with the refit kit, then met with existing line units utilizing stock LGN-2Ks to execute special missions. This ability to play shell games with hyper lasers served the Republic relatively well, with verified or suspected instances of LGN-2K-RISC deployments being more widespread than the limited production of the hyper laser would otherwise allow. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Created to provide armor and firepower on the cheap, the Ironclad is marketed to militias and planetary defence forces unable to afford the maintenance costs of operating a fusion powered battlemech. Manufactured by Heavy Duty Galatea in 3041, the Ironclad IC-100 has since become a staple of the Galatean Defence Force and has made inroads into Lyran space. Powered by a 200 rated Fuel Cell Engine, the Ironclad is a slow and ponderous mountain of armor and guns. A pair of Gauss Rifles provide heavy ranged fire while a battery of Medium and Small Lasers paired with a trio of Small Pulse Lasers shred enemies that attempt to close in. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: The Thanatos is a sturdy, hard-hitting BattleMech conceived to emulate the Clan Thor OmniMech. After years licensing OmniMechs, StarCorps Industries mastered the technology and in 3060 designed their own, debuting Thanatos as an OmniMech. However, the LAAF and AFFS, citing cost and existing inventory, declined new Omni designs. Pivoting, StarCorps converted it to a standard ’Mech and resubmitted; militaries adopted it. The Thanatos excels in heavy cavalry roles, often combined with other fast 'Mechs.

content.original: The TNS-7D2 is a direct offshoot of the -7D that replaces the ECM suite with an Artemis V fire-control system to tighten missile groupings and improve hit consistency. All other primary systems remain the same, including mobility and the mixed laser-missile armament. The tradeoff is reduced electronic protection and a logistics requirement for Artemis-compatible ammunition, positioning the -7D2 as a precision-biased missile variant. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The -N4 variant replaces the standard internal structure with ultralight composite, freeing mass for added armor and a stealth package derived from the Chameleon light polarization shield. Heat efficiency improves, but the lighter frame is more fragile, suiting the 'Mech to fringe engagements. Armament shifts from twin Gauss rifles to a mixed pair, one standard Gauss and one Silver Bullet Gauss, so it can open up armor and immediately saturate the breach with cluster fire. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Developed by Iroquois Machinery in the mid 3140s, the Broadside is an unusual offering from a company better known for being a major manufacturer of industrial mechs. A 100 ton mech powered by a 300 rated fusion engine, the Broadside is a rapidly proliferating sigh in the increasingly strained ranks of the AFFS. Heavily armed with a myriad of weapons, the Broadsword BS-1D is armed with an LB10-X AC, a UAC/10 and a RAC/5. For secondary armament, it carries a pair of ER Medium Lasers, a Flamer and a pair of Re-engineered Medium Lasers. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Created to provide armor and firepower on the cheap, the Ironclad is marketed to militias and planetary defence forces unable to afford the maintenance costs of operating a fusion powered battlemech. Manufactured by Heavy Duty Galatea in 3041, the Ironclad IC-100 has since become a staple of the Galatean Defence Force and has made inroads into Lyran space. Powered by a 200 rated Fuel Cell Engine, the Ironclad is a slow and ponderous mountain of armor and guns. A pair of Gauss Rifles provide heavy ranged fire while a battery of Medium and Small Lasers paired with a trio of Small Pulse Lasers shred enemies that attempt to close in. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: The TNS-7D2 is a direct offshoot of the -7D that replaces the ECM suite with an Artemis V fire-control system to tighten missile groupings and improve hit consistency. All other primary systems remain the same, including mobility and the mixed laser-missile armament. The tradeoff is reduced electronic protection and a logistics requirement for Artemis-compatible ammunition, positioning the -7D2 as a precision-biased missile variant. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The -N4 variant replaces the standard internal structure with ultralight composite, freeing mass for added armor and a stealth package derived from the Chameleon light polarization shield. Heat efficiency improves, but the lighter frame is more fragile, suiting the 'Mech to fringe engagements. Armament shifts from twin Gauss rifles to a mixed pair, one standard Gauss and one Silver Bullet Gauss, so it can open up armor and immediately saturate the breach with cluster fire. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The Falconer was designed at the order of Hanse Davion to create a 'Mech that could tame the Jade Falcons and defeat a Clan OmniMech in one-on-one combat. The Falconer is powered by a 375 XL engine that propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 86.4 km/h. This speed is enhanced with greater mobility by fiv jump jets that allow the Falconer to jump the considerable distance of one hundred and fifty meters. The Falconer also saves weight to carry as many weapons as possible by using a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and carries eleven and a half tons of armor plating, which gives the Falconer a respectable amount of armor protection.

Машина оснащена двигателем XL 375, обеспечивающим максимальную скорость 86,4 км/ч. Высокая мобильность дополнительно повышается за счёт пяти прыжковых двигателей, позволяющих Falconer преодолевать по воздуху значительное расстояние в 150 метров. Для экономии массы и размещения максимально возможного количества вооружения в конструкции использовано шасси из более лёгкой эндостали, а наличие одиннадцати с половиной тонн брони обеспечивает меху достойный уровень защиты.

content.original: The Hermes III HER-7K is the latests upgrade of the Hermes III by Luthien Armor Works, introducing all the hottest new tech into the design. Combining a Angel ECM and a Bloodhound probe provides excellent electronic warfare capabilities, while a Supercharger replaces the Jump Jets of earlier variants for improved bursts of speed. It's weapons are two clan tech Extended Range Large Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The Hermes III was created by Ostmann Industries by taking a Hermes II HER-2S and adapting it to the available technology in the Draconis Combine at that time. Its main goal was to act as a smaller companion to the Ostsol line, retaining the scouting and light skirmisher role of the original Hermes and Hermes II. As the demand for more upgraded mechs in these roles started growing, Luthien Armor Works upgraded a number of ageing first generation Hermes III to modern standards.

Quad Plasma Rifles form the primary weaponry, backed up by a Snub Nose PPC and a single Rocket Launcher 15. Combining a Angel ECM and a Bloodhound probe provides excellent electronic warfare capabilities, while a Supercharger replaces the Jump Jets of earlier variants for improved bursts of speed. It's weapons are two clan tech Extended Range Large Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.content: Hermes III HER-7K — это новейшая модификация модели Hermes III от компании Luthien Armor Works, в конструкции которой воплощены самые передовые технологии. Сочетание системы РЭБ Angel и зонда Bloodhound обеспечивает превосходные возможности ведения радиоэлектронной борьбы, а установленный вместо прыжковых двигателей (характерных для предыдущих версий) нагнетатель позволяет совершать рывки на повышенной скорости. Вооружение меха состоит из двух клановых больших лазеров повышенной дальности. Особенность: Прост в обслуживании Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.02

content.original: Designed and produced for the Magistracy of Canopus; as part of an upgrade of mothballed Succession Wars era Mechs, the KGC-0010M takes the already fearsome King Crab and upgrades it with new weapons and 2.5 tons of extra armor. Quad Plasma Rifles form the primary weaponry, backed up by a Snub Nose PPC and a single Rocket Launcher 15. A Beagle Active Probe is the last addition, perfect for the ecm choked battlefields of the 32nd century. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.content: Модель KGC-0010M, разработанная и произведенная для Магистрата Канопуса в рамках программы модернизации законсервированных мехов эпохи Войн за Наследие, представляет собой усовершенствованную версию и без того грозного «Кинг Краба», оснащенную новым вооружением и 2,5 тоннами дополнительной броней. Основным вооружением служат четыре плазменные винтовки, дополненные укороченной PPC и одной Rocket Launcher 15. Завершает комплектацию активный зонд Beagle — незаменимое устройство для полей сражений XXXII века, перенасыщенных системами РЭБ. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.18
